title.zh: 卷二百一十 列傳第九十七: 外夷三 緬國 占城 暹國 爪哇 瑠求 三嶼 馬八兒等國
title.en: Volume 210 Biographies 97: Foreign Peoples 3 - Myanmar, Champa, Siam, Java, Liuqiu, Batanes, Maba'erdengguo
title.raw: 卷二百一十 列傳第九十七: 外夷三 緬國 占城 暹國 爪哇 瑠求 三嶼 馬八兒等國 Volume 210 Biographies 97: Foreign Peoples 3 - Myanmar, Champa, Siam, Java, Liuqiu, Batanes, Maba'erdengguo

sentences.zh: 緬國為西南夷，不知何種。

translations.literal: Burma was a southwestern barbarian people; its ethnic stock was unknown.
translations.idiomatic: Burma was counted among the southwestern frontier peoples, though its exact origins were unknown.

sentences.zh: 其地有接大理及去成都不遠者，又不知其方幾里也。

translations.literal: There were parts of its territory adjacent to Dali and not far from Chengdu, but how many li it was in that direction was also unknown.
translations.idiomatic: Some parts of its territory bordered Dali and lay not far from Chengdu, but the exact distance in that direction was unknown.

sentences.zh: 其人有城郭屋廬以居，有象馬以乘，舟筏以濟。

translations.literal: Its people lived in walled cities, houses, and dwellings; they rode elephants and horses, and crossed rivers by boat and raft.
translations.idiomatic: Its people lived in walled towns and houses, traveled on elephants and horses, and crossed rivers by boat and raft.

sentences.zh: 其文字進上者，用金葉寫之，次用紙，又次用檳榔葉，蓋騰譯而後通也。

translations.literal: When submitting documents upward, they wrote on gold leaf first, then paper, then betel leaves—it had to be transcribed before it could be understood.
translations.idiomatic: Documents presented to the court were first written on gold leaf, then on paper, and finally on betel leaves; they had to be transcribed before they could be understood.

sentences.zh: 世祖至元八年，大理、鄯闡等路宣慰司都元帥府遣乞脫因等使緬國，招諭其主內附。

translations.literal: In the eighth year of the Zhiyuan era of Emperor Shizu, the Pacification Commissioner's headquarters of the Dali, Shanhan, and other circuits sent Qutuin and others as envoys to Burma to summon and persuade its ruler to submit.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year of the Zhiyuan era under Emperor Shizu, the Pacification Commissioner's headquarters for the Dali and Shanhan circuits dispatched Qutuin and others to Burma to invite its ruler to submit.

sentences.zh: 四月，乞脫因等導其使价博來，以聞。

translations.literal: In the fourth month, Qutuin and the others escorted their envoy Jia Bo to court to report.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month, Qutuin and his party escorted the Burmese envoy Jia Bo to the capital to deliver their report.

sentences.zh: 十年二月，遣勘馬剌失里、乞脫因等使其國，持詔諭之曰：「間者大理、鄯闡等路宣慰司都元帥府差乞脫因導王國使价博詣京師，且言嚮至王國，但見其臣下，未嘗見王，又欲觀吾大國舍利。

translations.literal: In the second month of the tenth year, Kanmalasiri, Qutuin, and others were dispatched to that country with an imperial edict instructing them: "Recently the Pacification Commissioner's headquarters of the Dali and Shanhan circuits sent Qutuin to escort your kingdom's envoy Jia Bo to the capital. He reported that on his previous visit to your kingdom he had seen only your ministers and had never been granted audience with the king, and that he also wished to view the Buddhist relics of our great state."
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of the tenth year, Kanmalasiri, Qutuin, and others were sent to their country bearing an imperial edict that read: "Recently the Pacification Commissioner's headquarters for Dali and Shanhan dispatched Qutuin to escort your kingdom's envoy Jia Bo to the capital. He reported that on his earlier visit to your kingdom he had met only your ministers and never the king himself, and that he also wished to view the sacred relics of our great empire."

sentences.zh: 朕矜憫遠來，即使來使覲見，又令縱觀舍利。

translations.literal: I, taking pity on his long journey, immediately granted the envoy an audience and also permitted him to view the relics freely.
translations.idiomatic: Moved by compassion for their long journey, I immediately received the envoy in audience and allowed him free viewing of the relics.

sentences.zh: 益詢其所來，乃知王有內附意。

translations.literal: Further inquiry into his purpose revealed that the king harbored the intention of submitting.
translations.idiomatic: Further questioning about their mission revealed that the king intended to submit.

sentences.zh: 國雖云遠，一視同仁。

translations.literal: Though the country is said to be far away, we treat all with equal benevolence.
translations.idiomatic: Though your kingdom lies far away, we regard all peoples with equal benevolence.

sentences.zh: 今再遣勘馬剌失里及禮部郎中國信使乞脫因、工部郎中國信副使小云失往諭王國。

translations.literal: Now we again send Kanmalasiri, with Guoxin of the Ministry of Rites as chief envoy and Qutuin as envoy, and Guoxin of the Ministry of Works as deputy envoy with Xiaoyunshi, to go and instruct your kingdom.
translations.idiomatic: We now again dispatch Kanmalasiri, with Guoxin of the Ministry of Rites as chief envoy and Qutuin as envoy, and Guoxin of the Ministry of Works as deputy envoy with Xiaoyunshi, to convey our message to your kingdom.

sentences.zh: 誠能謹事大之禮，遣其子弟若貴近臣僚一來，以彰我國家無外之義，用敦永好，時乃之休。

translations.literal: If you can truly observe the rites of serving the greater power and send one of your sons or close ministers to come, this will display our state's principle of making no distinctions between inner and outer, cement lasting friendship, and bring timely peace.
translations.idiomatic: If you will faithfully observe the rites owed to a suzerain and send a son or close minister to court, this will demonstrate our empire's principle of treating all alike, foster lasting friendship, and bring timely peace.

sentences.zh: 至若用兵，夫誰所好。

translations.literal: As for resorting to force of arms, who would welcome that?
translations.idiomatic: As for waging war, who would truly desire it?

sentences.zh: 王其思之。」

translations.literal: Your Majesty should consider this carefully."
translations.idiomatic: Your Majesty should weigh this carefully."

sentences.zh: 十二年四月，建寧路安撫使賀天爵言得金齒頭目阿郭之言曰：「乞脫因之使緬，乃故父阿必所指也。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of the twelfth year, He Tianjue, Pacification Commissioner of Jianning Circuit, reported words obtained from the Gold-Tooth chieftain Aguo, saying: "Qutuin's mission to Burma was directed by my late father Abi."
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of the twelfth year, He Tianjue, Pacification Commissioner of Jianning Circuit, relayed a report from Gold-Tooth chieftain Aguo: "Qutuin's mission to Burma was arranged at the direction of my late father Abi."

sentences.zh: 至元九年三月，緬王恨父阿必，故領兵數萬來侵，執父阿必而去。

translations.literal: In the third month of the ninth year of Zhiyuan, the king of Burma bore a grudge against my father Abi, and so led tens of thousands of troops to invade, seized my father Abi, and carried him off.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of the ninth Zhiyuan year, the king of Burma, harboring a grudge against my father Abi, led tens of thousands of troops in an invasion, seized him, and carried him away.

sentences.zh: 不得已厚獻其國，乃得釋之。

translations.literal: We had no choice but to make lavish gifts to their country before he was released.
translations.idiomatic: Only after lavish gifts were sent to their country could we obtain his release.

sentences.zh: 因知緬中部落之人猶群狗耳。

translations.literal: From this I learned that the tribal people of central Burma are no better than a pack of dogs.
translations.idiomatic: From this I learned that the tribal peoples of central Burma are little better than a pack of dogs.

sentences.zh: 比者緬遣阿的八等九人至，乃候視國家動靜也。

translations.literal: Recently Burma sent Adiba and eight others here—they were in fact spying on our state's movements.
translations.idiomatic: Recently Burma sent Adiba and eight others to our borders; they were in fact there to observe our state's movements.

sentences.zh: 今白衣頭目是阿郭親戚，與緬為鄰。

translations.literal: Now the White-Clothed chieftain is a kinsman of Aguo and a neighbor of Burma.
translations.idiomatic: The White-Clothed chieftain is a kinsman of Aguo and lives adjacent to Burma.

sentences.zh: 嘗謂入緬有三道，一由天部馬，一由驃甸，一由阿郭地界，俱會緬之江頭城。

translations.literal: He once said there are three routes into Burma: one by way of Tianbuma, one by Biaodian, and one through Aguo's territory—all converging at Burma's Jiangtou City.
translations.idiomatic: He has said that there are three routes into Burma: one through Tianbuma, one through Biaodian, and one through Aguo's territory—all converging at Burma's Jiangtou City.

sentences.zh: 又阿郭親戚阿提犯在緬掌五甸，戶各萬餘，欲內附。

translations.literal: Moreover, Aguo's kinsman Atifan holds five districts in Burma with more than ten thousand households each and wishes to submit.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover, Aguo's kinsman Atifan governs five districts in Burma, each with more than ten thousand households, and wishes to submit to us.

sentences.zh: 阿郭願先招阿提犯及金齒之未降者，以為引道。

translations.literal: Aguo is willing first to win over Atifan and those among the Gold-Tooth who have not yet surrendered, to serve as guides.
translations.idiomatic: Aguo offers first to win over Atifan and the Gold-Tooth groups that have not yet surrendered, to serve as our guides.

sentences.zh: 」雲南省因言緬王無降心，去使不返，必須征討。

translations.literal: The Yunnan Secretariat therefore reported that the king of Burma had no intention of surrendering, that the envoys sent had not returned, and that a punitive expedition was necessary.
translations.idiomatic: The Yunnan Secretariat reported that the king of Burma showed no sign of submission and that our envoys had not returned, and argued that a punitive campaign was necessary.

sentences.zh: 六月，樞密院以聞。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, the Bureau of Military Affairs reported this to the throne.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, the Bureau of Military Affairs reported the matter to the throne.

sentences.zh: 帝曰：「姑緩之。

translations.literal: The emperor said: "For now, hold back."
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said: "For now, delay action."

sentences.zh: 」十一月，雲南省始報：「差人探伺國使消息，而蒲賊阻道，今蒲人多降，道已通，遣金齒千額緫管阿禾探得國使達緬俱安。」

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, the Yunnan Secretariat at last reported: "We sent men to inquire after our envoys, but Pu bandits blocked the road. Now many Pu have surrendered, the route is open, and we dispatched Gold-Tooth Qian'e commander Ahe, who found that our envoys had reached Burma and were safe."
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, the Yunnan Secretariat reported: "Men were sent to learn news of our envoys, but Pu bandits blocked the route. Now many Pu have surrendered and the road is open; we dispatched Gold-Tooth commander Ahe of Qian'e, who confirmed that our envoys had reached Burma safely."

sentences.zh: 十四年三月，緬人以阿禾內附，怨之，攻其地，欲立寨騰越、永昌之間。

translations.literal: In the third month of the fourteenth year, the Burmese resented Ahe's submission and attacked his territory, intending to establish fortifications between Tengyue and Yongchang.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of the fourteenth year, the Burmese, angered by Ahe's submission, attacked his territory and sought to build fortifications between Tengyue and Yongchang.

sentences.zh: 時大理路蒙古千戶忽都、大理路緫管信苴日、緫把千戶脫羅脫孩奉命伐永昌之西騰越、蒲、驃、阿昌、金齒未降部族，駐劄南甸。

translations.literal: At that time Hudu, Mongol Company Commander of Dali Circuit; Xinjueri, Administrator of Dali Circuit; and Tuoluotuohai, Chief Company Commander, were ordered to campaign against the unsubmissive tribes of Tengyue, Pu, Biao, Achang, and Gold-Tooth west of Yongchang, and were encamped at Nandian.
translations.idiomatic: At that time Hudu, Mongol company commander of Dali Circuit; Xinjueri, administrator of Dali Circuit; and Tuoluotuohai, chief company commander, had been ordered to campaign against the unsubmissive Tengyue, Pu, Biao, Achang, and Gold-Tooth tribes west of Yongchang, and were encamped at Nandian.

sentences.zh: 阿禾告急，忽都等晝夜行，與緬軍遇一河邊，其衆約四五萬，象八百，馬萬匹。

translations.literal: Ahe sent urgent word for help. Hudu and the others marched day and night and met the Burmese army on a riverbank. Their force numbered about forty to fifty thousand, with eight hundred elephants and ten thousand horses.
translations.idiomatic: Ahe sent urgent word for help. Hudu and his men marched day and night and met the Burmese army on a riverbank. The enemy numbered roughly forty to fifty thousand, with eight hundred elephants and ten thousand horses.

sentences.zh: 忽都等軍僅七百人。

translations.literal: Hudu and his men had only seven hundred troops.
translations.idiomatic: Hudu and his force numbered only seven hundred men.

sentences.zh: 緬人前乘馬，次象，次步卒；

translations.literal: The Burmese arrayed cavalry in front, elephants next, and infantry last.
translations.idiomatic: The Burmese formation placed cavalry in front, elephants next, and infantry in the rear.

sentences.zh: 象被甲，背負戰樓，兩旁挾大竹筩，置短槍數十於其中，乘象者取以擊刺。

translations.literal: The elephants wore armor, carried fighting towers on their backs, and had large bamboo tubes attached on both sides holding dozens of short spears, which the riders on the elephants took up to strike and thrust.
translations.idiomatic: The elephants wore armor and bore fighting towers on their backs. Large bamboo tubes were strapped to either side, each holding dozens of short spears for the riders to strike and thrust with.

sentences.zh: 忽都下令：「賊衆我寡，當先衝河北軍。

translations.literal: Hudu gave the order: "The enemy are many and we are few; we must first charge the army north of the river."
translations.idiomatic: Hudu ordered: "The enemy outnumber us; we must first charge the army north of the river."

sentences.zh: 」親率二百八十一騎為一隊，信苴日以二百三十三騎傍河為一隊，脫羅脫孩以一百八十七人依山為一隊。

translations.literal: He personally led two hundred eighty-one horsemen as one unit; Xinjueri took two hundred thirty-three horsemen along the river as another unit; Tuoluotuohai took one hundred eighty-seven men on the hills as a third unit.
translations.idiomatic: He personally led two hundred eighty-one horsemen as one unit; Xinjueri took two hundred thirty-three horsemen along the river as another; and Tuoluotuohai took one hundred eighty-seven men on the high ground as a third.

sentences.zh: 交戰良久，賊敗走。

translations.literal: After fighting for a long time, the enemy were defeated and fled.
translations.idiomatic: After a long engagement, the enemy were routed and fled.

sentences.zh: 信苴日追之三里，抵寨門，旋濘而退。

translations.literal: Xinjueri pursued them for three li to the gate of their camp, then turned back through the mire.
translations.idiomatic: Xinjueri pursued them three li to the enemy camp gate, then withdrew through the swampy ground.

sentences.zh: 忽南面賊兵萬餘，繞出官軍後。

translations.literal: Suddenly more than ten thousand enemy troops to the south swept around behind the government army.
translations.idiomatic: Suddenly more than ten thousand enemy troops to the south swept around behind the government forces.

sentences.zh: 信苴日馳報，忽都復列為三陣，進至河岸，擊之，又敗走。

translations.literal: Xinjueri raced back to report. Hudu again formed three battle lines, advanced to the riverbank, struck them, and once more routed them.
translations.idiomatic: Xinjueri raced back to report. Hudu again formed three battle lines, advanced to the riverbank, attacked them, and once more put them to flight.

sentences.zh: 追破其十七寨，逐北至窄山口，轉戰三十餘里，賊及象馬自相蹂死者盈三巨溝。

translations.literal: They pursued and broke seventeen camps, driving the enemy north to Zhainankou. After fighting for more than thirty li, enemy soldiers, elephants, and horses trampled one another to death until three great ditches were filled.
translations.idiomatic: They pursued and broke seventeen camps, driving the enemy north to Zhainankou. After thirty-odd li of fighting, enemy soldiers, elephants, and horses trampled one another to death until three great ditches were filled with corpses.

sentences.zh: 日暮，忽都中傷，遂收兵。

translations.literal: At dusk Hudu was wounded, and they withdrew the army.
translations.idiomatic: At dusk Hudu was wounded, and the army withdrew.

sentences.zh: 明日，追之，至千額，不及而還。

translations.literal: The next day they pursued to Qian'e but failed to overtake the enemy and returned.
translations.idiomatic: The next day they pursued as far as Qian'e but failed to overtake the enemy and returned.

sentences.zh: 捕虜甚衆，軍中以一帽或一兩靴一氊衣易一生口。

translations.literal: Many captives were taken. In the army one hat, one pair of boots, or one felt garment could be exchanged for one living captive.
translations.idiomatic: Many captives were taken. Within the army, a hat, a pair of boots, or a felt garment could be traded for one living captive.

sentences.zh: 其脫者又為阿禾、阿昌邀殺，歸者無幾。

translations.literal: Those who escaped were again ambushed and killed by Ahe and the Achang; few made it home.
translations.idiomatic: Those who escaped were ambushed and killed by Ahe and the Achang; few made it home alive.

sentences.zh: 官軍負傷者雖多，惟蒙古軍獲一象不得其性被擊而斃，餘無死者。

translations.literal: Though many in the government army were wounded, among the Mongol troops only one elephant was obtained; they did not understand its nature and it was struck and killed. Otherwise there were no dead.
translations.idiomatic: Though many government troops were wounded, among the Mongols only one elephant was taken—and because they did not know how to manage it, it was struck and killed. There were no other deaths.

sentences.zh: 十月，雲南省遣雲南諸路宣慰使元帥納速剌丁率蒙古、爨、僰、摩些軍三千八百四十餘人征緬，至江頭，深蹂酋首細安立寨之所，招降其磨欲等三百餘寨土官曲蠟蒲折戶四千、孟磨愛呂戶一千、磨柰蒙匡里荅八剌戶二萬、蒙忙甸土官甫祿堡戶一萬、木都彈禿戶二百，凡三萬五千二百戶，以天熱還師。

translations.literal: In the tenth month, the Yunnan Secretariat dispatched Nasir al-Din, Pacification Commissioner and Marshal of the Various Circuits of Yunnan, leading more than three thousand eight hundred forty Mongol, Cuan, Bo, and Mosuo troops to campaign against Burma. Reaching Jiangtou, they deeply raided the place where chieftain Xi'an had established his camp, and won over to submission the more than three hundred stockaded chiefs of Moyu and others: Quila of four thousand households, Mengmo Ailu of one thousand households, Monai Mengkuangli Dabala of twenty thousand households, the Mengmang chieftain Fulu of ten thousand households, and Mudan Tu of two hundred households—in all thirty-five thousand two hundred households. Because of the heat they withdrew the army.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, the Yunnan Secretariat dispatched Nasir al-Din, Pacification Commissioner and Marshal of the Various Circuits of Yunnan, at the head of more than three thousand eight hundred forty Mongol, Cuan, Bo, and Mosuo troops to campaign against Burma. Reaching Jiangtou, they raided deep into the stronghold of chieftain Xi'an and won the submission of more than three hundred stockaded chiefs under Moyu and others: Quila with four thousand households, Mengmo Ailu with one thousand, Monai Mengkuangli Dabala with twenty thousand, the Mengmang chieftain Fulu with ten thousand, and Mudan Tu with two hundred—in all thirty-five thousand two hundred households. Because of the heat they withdrew.

sentences.zh: 十七年二月，納速剌丁等上言：「緬國輿地形勢皆在臣目中矣。

translations.literal: In the second month of the seventeenth year, Nasir al-Din and others memorialized: "The terrain and strategic positions of Burma are all within my sight."
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of the seventeenth year, Nasir al-Din and others memorialized: "The terrain and strategic positions of Burma are all clear to me."

sentences.zh: 先奉旨，若重慶諸郡平，然後有事緬國。

translations.literal: We were previously instructed that only after the various prefectures of Chongqing were pacified should action be taken against Burma.
translations.idiomatic: We were previously instructed that action against Burma should wait until the prefectures of Chongqing were pacified.

sentences.zh: 今四川已底寧，請益兵征之。

translations.literal: Now Sichuan is already settled; we request additional troops to campaign against it.
translations.idiomatic: Now that Sichuan is settled, we request additional troops for the campaign.

sentences.zh: 」帝以問丞相脫里奪海，脫里奪海曰：「陛下初命發合剌章及四川與阿里海牙麾下士卒六萬人征緬，今納速剌丁止欲得萬人。

translations.literal: The emperor asked Chancellor Toqto about this. Toqto said: "Your Majesty initially ordered sixty thousand troops from Qara'ul and from under Ali Haiya in Sichuan to campaign against Burma. Now Nasir al-Din wants only ten thousand."
translations.idiomatic: The emperor consulted Chancellor Toqto, who said: "Your Majesty initially ordered sixty thousand troops from Qara'ul and from Ali Haiya's forces in Sichuan for the Burma campaign. Now Nasir al-Din asks for only ten thousand."

sentences.zh: 」帝曰：「是矣。

translations.literal: The emperor said: "That is right."
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said: "That will do."

sentences.zh: 」即命樞密繕甲兵，修武備，議選將出師。

translations.literal: He immediately ordered the Bureau of Military Affairs to repair armor and weapons, improve military readiness, and discuss selecting generals to take the field.
translations.idiomatic: He immediately ordered the Bureau of Military Affairs to repair armor and weapons, improve military readiness, and select generals for the expedition.

sentences.zh: 五月，詔雲南行省發四川軍萬人，命藥剌海領之，與前所遣將同征緬。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, an edict ordered the Yunnan Branch Secretariat to dispatch ten thousand Sichuan troops under the command of Yiruhai to campaign against Burma together with the generals previously sent.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, an edict ordered the Yunnan Branch Secretariat to dispatch ten thousand Sichuan troops under Yiruhai to join the previously sent generals in the campaign against Burma.

sentences.zh: 十九年二月，詔思、播、敘諸郡及亦奚不薛諸蠻夷等處發士卒征緬。

translations.literal: In the second month of the nineteenth year, an edict ordered troops to be raised from the prefectures of Si, Bo, and Xu and from the various barbarian regions of Yixi Bxie and elsewhere for the campaign against Burma.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of the nineteenth year, an edict ordered troops to be raised from the prefectures of Si, Bo, and Xu and from the various tribal regions of Yixi Bxie and elsewhere for the Burma campaign.

sentences.zh: 二十年十一月，官軍伐緬，克之。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month of the twentieth year, the government army campaigned against Burma and conquered it.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month of the twentieth year, the government army campaigned against Burma and conquered it.

sentences.zh: 先是，詔宗王相吾荅兒、右丞太卜、參知政事也罕的斤將兵征緬。

translations.literal: Earlier, an edict had ordered Prince Sang'adar, Right Chancellor Taibu, and Vice Administrator Yehan Dejin to lead troops against Burma.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, an edict had ordered Prince Sang'adar, Right Chancellor Taibu, and Vice Administrator Yehan Dejin to lead the expedition against Burma.

sentences.zh: 是年九月，大軍發中慶。

translations.literal: In the ninth month of that year, the main army set out from Zhongqing.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month of that year, the main army set out from Zhongqing.

sentences.zh: 十月，至南甸，太卜由羅必甸進軍。

translations.literal: In the tenth month they reached Nandian. Taibu advanced by way of Luobidian.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month they reached Nandian, and Taibu advanced by way of Luobidian.

sentences.zh: 十一月，相吾荅兒命也罕的斤取道於阿昔江，達鎮西阿禾江，造舟二百，下流至江頭城，斷緬人水路；

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, Sang'adar ordered Yehan Dejin to take the route by the Axi River, reach the Ahe River in Zhenxi, build two hundred boats, and descend downstream to Jiangtou City to cut off the Burmese water route.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, Sang'adar ordered Yehan Dejin to take the route by the Axi River, reach the Ahe River in Zhenxi, build two hundred boats, and descend downstream to Jiangtou City to cut off the Burmese water route.

sentences.zh: 自將一軍從驃甸徑抵其國，與太卜軍會。

translations.literal: He himself led one army straight through Biaodian to reach their country and joined Taibu's army.
translations.idiomatic: He himself led one army straight through Biaodian into their country and joined forces with Taibu.

sentences.zh: 令諸將分地攻取，破其江頭城，擊殺萬餘人。

translations.literal: He ordered the generals to attack and seize territory in separate sectors, broke Jiangtou City, and killed more than ten thousand men.
translations.idiomatic: He ordered the generals to attack and seize territory in separate sectors, captured Jiangtou City, and killed more than ten thousand men.

sentences.zh: 別令都元帥袁世安以兵守其地，積糧餉以給軍士，遣使持輿地圖奏上。

translations.literal: He separately ordered Grand Marshal Yuan Shi'an to hold the territory with troops, accumulate provisions to supply the soldiers, and send envoys bearing a territorial map to present to the throne.
translations.idiomatic: He separately ordered Grand Marshal Yuan Shi'an to hold the territory, accumulate provisions for the troops, and send envoys bearing a territorial map to the throne.

sentences.zh: 二十二年十一月，緬王遣其鹽井大官阿必立相至太公城，欲來納款，為孟乃甸白衣頭目塞阻道，不得行，遣謄馬宅者持信搭一片來告，驃甸土官匿俗乞報上司免軍馬入境，匿俗給榜遣謄馬宅回江頭城招阿必立相赴省，且報鎮西、平緬、麗川等路宣慰司、宣撫司，差三摻持榜至江頭城付阿必立相、忙直卜筭二人，期以兩月領軍來江頭城，宣撫司率蒙古軍至驃甸相見議事。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month of the twenty-second year, the king of Burma sent his Salt Wells Grand Officer Abi Lixiang to Taigong City, intending to come and submit. He was blocked on the road by the White-Clothed chieftain of Mengnai, could not proceed, and sent Tengmazhaizhe with a letter tablet to report. The Biaodian chieftain Nisu begged that superiors be informed to exempt troops from entering his territory. Nisu issued a placard and sent Tengmazhaizhe back to Jiangtou City to summon Abi Lixiang to the secretariat, and also notified the Pacification Commissions and Pacification Offices of Zhenxi, Pingmian, Lichuan, and other circuits, dispatching three San officials with the placard to Jiangtou City to deliver it to Abi Lixiang and Mangzhi Bosuan, setting a two-month deadline for them to lead troops to Jiangtou City, where the Pacification Office would lead Mongol troops to Biaodian to meet and discuss affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month of the twenty-second year, the king of Burma sent his Salt Wells Grand Officer Abi Lixiang to Taigong City intending to submit, but the White-Clothed chieftain of Mengnai blocked the route. Unable to proceed, he sent Tengmazhaizhe with a letter tablet to report. The Biaodian chieftain Nisu asked that superiors be told to keep troops from entering his territory. Nisu issued a placard and sent Tengmazhaizhe back to Jiangtou City to summon Abi Lixiang to the secretariat, and notified the Pacification Commissions and Offices of Zhenxi, Pingmian, Lichuan, and other circuits. Three San officials were sent with the placard to Jiangtou City for Abi Lixiang and Mangzhi Bosuan, setting a two-month deadline for them to lead troops to Jiangtou City, where the Pacification Office would lead Mongol troops to Biaodian for a meeting.

sentences.zh: 阿必立相乞言於朝廷，降旨許其悔過，然後差大官赴闕。

translations.literal: Abi Lixiang begged that the court issue an edict permitting his repentance, after which a grand officer could be sent to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: Abi Lixiang asked that the court issue an edict permitting his repentance before a grand officer would be sent to the capital.

sentences.zh: 朝廷尋遣鎮西平緬宣撫司達魯花赤兼招討使怯烈使其國。

translations.literal: The court soon dispatched Qielie, Darughachi and Pacification Commissioner of the Zhenxi Pingmian Pacification Office, to their country.
translations.idiomatic: The court soon dispatched Qielie, Darughachi and Pacification Commissioner of the Zhenxi Pingmian Pacification Office, as envoy to their country.

sentences.zh: 二十三年十月，以招討使張萬為征緬副都元帥，也先鐵木兒征緬招討司達魯花赤，千戶張成征緬招討使，並虎符。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of the twenty-third year, Zhang Wan was appointed Deputy Grand Marshal for the Burma Campaign, Yesen Temur was made Darughachi of the Burma Campaign Pacification Office, and Company Commander Zhang Cheng was made Pacification Commissioner for the Burma Campaign—all with tiger tallies.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of the twenty-third year, Zhang Wan was appointed Deputy Grand Marshal for the Burma Campaign, Yesen Temur was made Darughachi of the Burma Campaign Pacification Office, and Company Commander Zhang Cheng was made Pacification Commissioner for the Burma Campaign—all with tiger tallies.

sentences.zh: 敕造戰船，將兵六千人征緬，俾禿滿帶為都元帥緫之。

translations.literal: An edict ordered war vessels built and six thousand troops sent against Burma, with Tudmandai as Grand Marshal in overall command.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered war vessels built and six thousand troops sent against Burma, with Tudmandai as Grand Marshal in overall command.

sentences.zh: 雲南王以行省右丞愛魯奉旨征收金齒、察罕迭吉連地，撥軍一千人。

translations.literal: The Prince of Yunnan, through Branch Secretariat Right Chancellor Ailu acting on imperial orders, levied the territories of Gold-Tooth and Chahan Dijilian and allocated one thousand troops.
translations.idiomatic: The Prince of Yunnan, through Branch Secretariat Right Chancellor Ailu acting on imperial orders, levied the territories of Gold-Tooth and Chahan Dijilian and allocated one thousand troops.

sentences.zh: 是月，發中慶府，繼至永昌府，與征緬省官會，經阿昔甸，差軍五百人護送招緬使怯烈至太公城。

translations.literal: That month they set out from Zhongqing Prefecture, then reached Yongchang Prefecture and joined the provincial officials of the Burma campaign. Passing through Axidian, five hundred troops were dispatched to escort the Burma-recruitment envoy Qielie to Taigong City.
translations.idiomatic: That month they set out from Zhongqing Prefecture, reached Yongchang Prefecture, and joined the provincial officials of the Burma campaign. Passing through Axidian, five hundred troops were dispatched to escort the Burma envoy Qielie to Taigong City.

sentences.zh: 二十四年正月，至忙乃甸。

translations.literal: In the first month of the twenty-fourth year, they reached Mangnaidian.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the twenty-fourth year, they reached Mangnaidian.

sentences.zh: 緬王為其庶子不速速古里所執，囚於昔里怯荅剌之地，又害其嫡子三人，與大官木浪周等四人為逆，雲南王所命官阿難荅等亦受害。

translations.literal: The king of Burma was seized by his illegitimate son Bususuguli, imprisoned at Xili Qiedala, and three of his sons by the principal consort were killed. Together with the grand officers Mulangzhou and three others he rebelled, and the officials appointed by the Prince of Yunnan, including Ananda, were also harmed.
translations.idiomatic: The king of Burma was seized by his illegitimate son Bususuguli and imprisoned at Xili Qiedala; three of his sons by the principal consort were killed. Together with Grand Officer Mulangzhou and three others he rebelled, and officials appointed by the Prince of Yunnan, including Ananda, were also harmed.

sentences.zh: 二月，怯烈自忙乃甸登舟，留元送軍五百人于彼。

translations.literal: In the second month, Qielie boarded a boat at Mangnaidian, leaving the five hundred Yuan escort troops there.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, Qielie boarded a boat at Mangnaidian, leaving the five hundred Yuan escort troops behind.

sentences.zh: 雲南省請今秋進討，不聽。

translations.literal: The Yunnan Secretariat requested a punitive advance that autumn; the request was denied.
translations.idiomatic: The Yunnan Secretariat requested a punitive advance that autumn, but the request was denied.

sentences.zh: 既而雲南王與諸王進征，至蒲甘，喪師七千餘，緬始平，乃定歲貢方物。

translations.literal: Subsequently the Prince of Yunnan and the princes advanced in campaign to Pagan, lost more than seven thousand troops, and only then was Burma pacified, after which annual tribute goods were fixed.
translations.idiomatic: Subsequently the Prince of Yunnan and the princes advanced as far as Pagan, losing more than seven thousand troops before Burma was finally pacified and annual tribute was fixed.

sentences.zh: 大德元年二月，以緬王的立普哇拿阿迪提牙嘗遣其子信合八的奉表入朝，請歲輸銀二千五百兩、帛千匹、馴象二十、糧萬石，詔封的立普哇拿阿迪提牙為緬王，賜銀印，子信合八的為緬國世子，賜以虎符。

translations.literal: In the second month of the first year of Dade, because the king of Burma, Dipuwana Aditya, had sent his son Sinhabhadra with a memorial to court requesting to pay annually two thousand five hundred taels of silver, one thousand bolts of silk, twenty trained elephants, and ten thousand shi of grain, an edict enfeoffed Dipuwana Aditya as King of Burma and granted him a silver seal; his son Sinhabhadra was made Heir of Burma and granted a tiger tally.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of the first Dade year, because the king of Burma, Dipuwana Aditya, had sent his son Sinhabhadra to court with a memorial offering annual tribute of two thousand five hundred taels of silver, one thousand bolts of silk, twenty trained elephants, and ten thousand shi of grain, an edict enfeoffed Dipuwana Aditya as King of Burma and granted him a silver seal; his son Sinhabhadra was made Heir of Burma and granted a tiger tally.

sentences.zh: 三年三月，緬復遣其世子奉表入謝，自陳部民為金齒殺掠，率皆貧乏，以致上供金幣不能如期輸納。

translations.literal: In the third month of the third year, Burma again sent its heir with a memorial to express thanks, stating on its own behalf that its people had been killed and plundered by the Gold-Tooth and were mostly impoverished, so that the gold and coin owed in tribute could not be delivered on schedule.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of the third year, Burma again sent its heir to court with a memorial of thanks, explaining that its people had been killed and plundered by the Gold-Tooth and were mostly impoverished, so that tribute in gold and coin could not be delivered on schedule.

sentences.zh: 帝憫之，止命間歲貢象，仍賜衣遣還。

translations.literal: The emperor took pity on them and ordered only elephants to be sent in alternate years, and still granted robes before sending them back.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor took pity on them and required only elephants in alternate years, granted robes, and sent them back.

sentences.zh: 四年四月，遣使進白象。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of the fourth year, they sent envoys presenting a white elephant.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of the fourth year, they sent envoys presenting a white elephant.

sentences.zh: 五月，的立普哇拿阿迪提牙為其弟阿散哥也等所殺，其子窟麻剌哥撒八逃詣京師。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, Dipuwana Aditya was killed by his younger brother Asange and others. His son Kumara Kassapa fled to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, Dipuwana Aditya was killed by his younger brother Asange and others. His son Kumara Kassapa fled to the capital.

sentences.zh: 令忙完禿魯迷失率師往問其罪。

translations.literal: Mangwan Tuolushi was ordered to lead troops to investigate their crime.
translations.idiomatic: Mangwan Tuolushi was ordered to lead troops to investigate their crime.

sentences.zh: 蠻賊與八百媳婦國通，其勢張甚。

translations.literal: The barbarian rebels were in contact with the Kingdom of the Eight Hundred Wives, and their power grew greatly.
translations.idiomatic: The barbarian rebels were in league with the Kingdom of the Eight Hundred Wives, and their power grew greatly.

sentences.zh: 忙完禿魯迷失請益兵，又命薛超兀而等將兵萬二千人征之，仍令諸王闊闊節制其軍。

translations.literal: Mangwan Tuolushi requested additional troops. Xue Chao'uer and others were ordered to lead twelve thousand troops against them, and Prince Kuo Kuo was placed in overall command of the army.
translations.idiomatic: Mangwan Tuolushi requested additional troops. Xue Chao'uer and others were ordered to lead twelve thousand troops against them, with Prince Kuo Kuo placed in overall command.

sentences.zh: 六月，詔立窟麻剌哥撒八為王，賜以銀印。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, an edict installed Kumara Kassapa as king and granted him a silver seal.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, an edict installed Kumara Kassapa as king and granted him a silver seal.

sentences.zh: 秋七月，緬賊阿散哥也弟者蘇等九十一人各奉方物入朝，命餘人置中慶，遣者蘇等來上都。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, ninety-one men including Zhesu, younger brother of the Burmese rebel Asange, each presented local products at court. The rest were left at Zhongqing, and Zhesu and others were sent to the Upper Capital.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, ninety-one men including Zhesu, younger brother of the Burmese rebel Asange, each presented local products at court. The rest were left at Zhongqing, and Zhesu and others were sent to the Upper Capital.

sentences.zh: 八月，緬國阿散吉牙等昆弟赴闕，自言殺主之罪，罷征緬兵。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, Asanjiya and his brothers of Burma came to court, confessed the crime of killing their lord, and the Burma campaign troops were withdrawn.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, Asanjiya and his brothers of Burma came to court, confessed to killing their lord, and the Burma campaign troops were withdrawn.

sentences.zh: 五年九月，雲南參知政事高慶、宣撫使察罕不花伏誅。

translations.literal: In the ninth month of the fifth year, Gao Qing, Vice Administrator of Yunnan, and Chahan Buhua, Pacification Commissioner, were executed.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month of the fifth year, Gao Qing, Vice Administrator of Yunnan, and Chahan Buhua, Pacification Commissioner, were executed.

sentences.zh: 初，慶等從薛超兀而圍緬兩月，城中薪食俱盡，勢將出降，慶等受其重賂，以炎暑瘴疫為辭，輒引兵還。

translations.literal: Earlier, Qing and the others had followed Xue Chao'uer in besieging Burma for two months. Fuel and food in the city were exhausted and it was on the verge of surrender, but Qing and the others accepted heavy bribes from them and, citing heat, miasma, and pestilence as excuses, abruptly withdrew the army.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, Qing and the others had followed Xue Chao'uer in besieging Burma for two months. Fuel and food in the city were exhausted and surrender was imminent, but Qing and the others accepted heavy bribes and, citing heat, miasma, and pestilence, abruptly withdrew the army.

sentences.zh: 故誅之。

translations.literal: For this they were executed.
translations.idiomatic: For this they were executed.

sentences.zh: 十月，緬遣使入貢。

translations.literal: In the tenth month, Burma sent envoys to pay tribute.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, Burma sent envoys to pay tribute.

sentences.zh: 占城近瓊州，順風舟行一日可抵其國。

translations.literal: Champa lies near Qiongzhou; with a favorable wind a boat can reach its country in one day.
translations.idiomatic: Champa lies near Qiongzhou; with a favorable wind a boat can reach it in a single day.

sentences.zh: 世祖至元間廣南西道宣慰使馬成旺嘗請兵三千人、馬三百匹征之。

translations.literal: During the Zhiyuan era of Emperor Shizu, Ma Chengwang, Pacification Commissioner of the Guangnan West Circuit, once requested three thousand troops and three hundred horses to campaign against it.
translations.idiomatic: During Emperor Shizu's Zhiyuan era, Ma Chengwang, Pacification Commissioner of the Guangnan West Circuit, once requested three thousand troops and three hundred horses for a campaign against it.

sentences.zh: 十五年，左丞唆都以宋平遣人至占城，還言其王失里咱牙信合八剌麻哈迭瓦有內附意，詔降虎符，授榮祿大夫，封占城郡王。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year, after the pacification of Song, Left Chancellor Suodu sent men to Champa. On their return they reported that its king, Sri Jaya Simhavarman, intended to submit. An edict granted a tiger tally, conferred the title of Grand Master of Glorious Blessings, and enfeoffed him as Prince of Champa Commandery.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifteenth year, after the pacification of Song, Left Chancellor Suodu sent men to Champa. On their return they reported that its king, Sri Jaya Simhavarman, intended to submit. An edict granted a tiger tally, conferred the title of Grand Master of Glorious Blessings, and enfeoffed him as Prince of Champa Commandery.

sentences.zh: 十六年十二月，遣兵部侍郎教化的、緫管孟慶元、萬戶孫勝夫與唆都等使占城，諭其王入朝。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month of the sixteenth year, Vice Minister of War Jiaohuade, Administrator Meng Qingyuan, Ten-thousand-household Commander Sun Shengfu, and Suodu and others were sent as envoys to Champa to instruct its king to come to court.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month of the sixteenth year, Vice Minister of War Jiaohuade, Administrator Meng Qingyuan, Ten-thousand-household Commander Sun Shengfu, and Suodu and others were sent as envoys to Champa to summon its king to court.

sentences.zh: 十七年二月，占城國王保寶旦拏囉耶邛南詙占把地囉耶遣使貢方物，奉表降。

translations.literal: In the second month of the seventeenth year, the king of Champa, Po Bao Dan Nara Ya Qiong Nan Ba Zhan Ba Di La Ya, sent envoys presenting local products and a memorial of submission.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of the seventeenth year, the king of Champa, Po Bao Dan Nara Ya Qiong Nan Ba Zhan Ba Di La Ya, sent envoys presenting local products and a memorial of submission.

sentences.zh: 十九年十月，朝廷以占城國主孛由補剌者吾曩歲遣使來朝，稱臣內屬，遂命右丞唆都等即其地立省以撫安之。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of the nineteenth year, because the king of Champa, Jaya Indravarman, had sent envoys to court in a previous year declaring himself a subject and submitting, the court ordered Right Chancellor Suodu and others to establish a province on the spot to pacify and settle the region.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of the nineteenth year, because the king of Champa, Jaya Indravarman, had sent envoys to court in a previous year declaring himself a subject, the court ordered Right Chancellor Suodu and others to establish a provincial administration on the spot to pacify the region.

sentences.zh: 既而其子補的專國，負固弗服，萬戶何子志、千戶皇甫傑使暹國，宣慰使尤永賢、亞闌等使馬八兒國，舟經占城，皆被執，故遣兵征之。

translations.literal: Subsequently his son Bude seized control of the state, stubbornly refused submission, and when Ten-thousand-household Commander He Zizhi and Thousand-household Commander Huangfu Jie were sent as envoys to Siam, and Pacification Commissioners You Yongxian and Yalan and others were sent to Maba'er, their boats passing through Champa were all seized. For this reason troops were dispatched against it.
translations.idiomatic: Subsequently his son Bude seized control of the state and stubbornly refused submission. When Ten-thousand-household Commander He Zizhi and Thousand-household Commander Huangfu Jie were sent as envoys to Siam, and Pacification Commissioners You Yongxian and Yalan and others were sent to Maba'er, their boats passing through Champa were all seized. Troops were therefore dispatched against it.

sentences.zh: 帝曰：「老王無罪，逆命者乃其子與一蠻人耳。

translations.literal: The emperor said: "The old king is not guilty; those who defy orders are only his son and one barbarian."
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said: "The old king is not guilty; those who defy orders are only his son and one barbarian."

sentences.zh: 苟獲此兩人，當依曹彬故事，百姓不戮一人。」

translations.literal: If these two men are captured, we should follow the precedent of Cao Bin and not kill a single common person."
translations.idiomatic: If these two men are captured, we should follow the precedent of Cao Bin and not kill a single common person."

sentences.zh: 十一月，占城行省官率兵自廣州航海至占城港。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, the officials of the Champa Branch Secretariat led troops by sea from Guangzhou to Champa Harbor.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, the officials of the Champa Branch Secretariat led troops by sea from Guangzhou to Champa Harbor.

sentences.zh: 港口北連海，海旁有小港五，通其國大州，東南止山，西旁木城。

translations.literal: The harbor connects north to the sea. Beside the sea are five small harbors leading to the great districts of the country. To the southeast are mountains; to the west is a wooden wall.
translations.idiomatic: The harbor opens north to the sea, with five smaller harbors beside it leading to the great districts of the country. Mountains lie to the southeast, and a wooden wall stands to the west.

sentences.zh: 官軍依海岸屯駐。

translations.literal: The government army encamped along the coast.
translations.idiomatic: The government army encamped along the coast.

sentences.zh: 占城兵治木城，四面約二十餘里，起樓棚，立回回三梢砲百餘座。

translations.literal: The Champa army repaired the wooden wall, about twenty-odd li on all sides, erected tower sheds, and set up more than one hundred Muslim trebuchets.
translations.idiomatic: The Champa army repaired the wooden wall, roughly twenty li around, erected tower sheds, and set up more than one hundred Muslim trebuchets.

sentences.zh: 又木城西十里建行宮，孛由補剌者吾親率重兵屯守應援。

translations.literal: Ten li west of the wooden wall they built a traveling palace, and Jaya Indravarman personally led heavy troops to garrison and support it.
translations.idiomatic: Ten li west of the wooden wall they built a traveling palace, and Jaya Indravarman personally led heavy troops to garrison it and provide support.

sentences.zh: 行省遣都鎮撫李天祐、緫把賈甫招之，七往，終不服。

translations.literal: The Branch Secretariat sent Chief Pacification Commissioner Li Tianyou and Chief Company Commander Jia Fu to summon them; they went seven times, but the enemy never submitted.
translations.idiomatic: The Branch Secretariat sent Chief Pacification Commissioner Li Tianyou and Chief Company Commander Jia Fu to summon them seven times, but the enemy never submitted.

sentences.zh: 十二月，招真臘國使速魯蠻請往招諭，復與天祐、甫偕行，得其回書云：「已修木城，備甲兵，刻期請戰。」

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, the envoy of Zhenla, Suluman, requested to go and summon them. He again went with Tianyou and Fu and received a reply stating: "We have repaired the wooden wall, prepared armor and troops, and set a date to request battle."
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, the Zhenla envoy Suluman requested to go and summon them. He again went with Tianyou and Fu and received a reply: "We have repaired the wooden wall, prepared armor and troops, and set a date to request battle."

sentences.zh: 二十年正月，行省傳令軍中，以十五日夜半發船攻城。

translations.literal: In the first month of the twentieth year, the Branch Secretariat transmitted orders to the army to launch boats and attack the city at midnight on the fifteenth.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the twentieth year, the Branch Secretariat ordered the army to launch boats and attack the city at midnight on the fifteenth.

sentences.zh: 至期，分遣瓊州安撫使陳仲達、緫管劉金、緫把栗全以兵千六百人由水路攻木城北面；

translations.literal: When the time came, they separately dispatched Chen Zhongda, Pacification Commissioner of Qiongzhou; Liu Jin, Administrator; and Li Quan, Chief Company Commander, with one thousand six hundred troops by water to attack the north side of the wooden wall.
translations.idiomatic: When the time came, Chen Zhongda, Pacification Commissioner of Qiongzhou; Liu Jin, Administrator; and Li Quan, Chief Company Commander, were dispatched with one thousand six hundred troops by water to attack the north side of the wooden wall.

sentences.zh: 緫把張斌、百戶趙達以三百人攻東面沙觜；

translations.literal: Chief Company Commander Zhang Bin and Company Commander Zhao Da took three hundred men to attack the eastern sand spit.
translations.idiomatic: Chief Company Commander Zhang Bin and Company Commander Zhao Da took three hundred men to attack the eastern sand spit.

sentences.zh: 省官三千人分三道攻南面。

translations.literal: Three thousand provincial officials divided into three routes to attack the south.
translations.idiomatic: Three thousand provincial troops divided into three columns to attack the south.

sentences.zh: 舟行至天明泊岸，為風濤所碎者十七八。

translations.literal: The boats sailed until dawn and then anchored; seventy or eighty percent were smashed by wind and waves.
translations.idiomatic: The boats sailed until dawn and anchored; seventy or eighty percent were smashed by wind and waves.

sentences.zh: 賊開木城南門，建旗鼓，出萬餘人，乘象者數十，亦分三隊迎敵，矢石交下。

translations.literal: The enemy opened the south gate of the wooden wall, raised banners and drums, and came out with more than ten thousand men, several dozen riding elephants, also divided into three units to meet the enemy as arrows and stones flew down.
translations.idiomatic: The enemy opened the south gate of the wooden wall, raised banners and drums, and came out with more than ten thousand men, several dozen riding elephants, also divided into three units to meet the attack as arrows and stones rained down.

sentences.zh: 自卯至午，賊敗北，官軍入木城，復與東北二軍合擊之，殺溺死者數千人。

translations.literal: From the hour of mao to the hour of wu the enemy were defeated and fled north. The government army entered the wooden wall, then joined with the northeastern forces in a combined attack, killing and drowning several thousand men.
translations.idiomatic: From dawn to midday the enemy were defeated and fled north. The government army entered the wooden wall, then joined with the northeastern forces in a combined attack, killing and drowning several thousand men.

sentences.zh: 守城供餉餽者數萬人悉潰散。

translations.literal: The tens of thousands who guarded the city and supplied provisions all broke and scattered.
translations.idiomatic: The tens of thousands who guarded the city and supplied provisions all broke and scattered.

sentences.zh: 國主棄行宮，燒倉廩，殺永賢、亞闌等，與其臣逃入山。

translations.literal: The king abandoned the traveling palace, burned the granaries, killed You Yongxian, Yalan, and others, and fled into the mountains with his ministers.
translations.idiomatic: The king abandoned the traveling palace, burned the granaries, killed You Yongxian, Yalan, and others, and fled into the mountains with his ministers.

sentences.zh: 十七日，整兵攻大州。

translations.literal: On the seventeenth day they reorganized the army and attacked the great district.
translations.idiomatic: On the seventeenth they reorganized the army and attacked the great district.

sentences.zh: 十九日，國主使報荅者來求降。

translations.literal: On the nineteenth day the king sent a messenger to reply and request surrender.
translations.idiomatic: On the nineteenth the king sent a messenger to reply and request surrender.

sentences.zh: 二十日，兵至大州東南，遣報荅者回，許其降，免罪。

translations.literal: On the twentieth day the army reached the southeast of the great district, sent the messenger back, and granted surrender with pardon.
translations.idiomatic: On the twentieth the army reached the southeast of the great district, sent the messenger back, and granted surrender with pardon.

sentences.zh: 二十一日，入大州。

translations.literal: On the twenty-first day they entered the great district.
translations.idiomatic: On the twenty-first they entered the great district.

sentences.zh: 又遣博思兀魯班者來言：「奉王命，國主、太子後當自來。

translations.literal: They again sent Bosi Wuluban to say: "By the king's order, the king and the crown prince will come in person later."
translations.idiomatic: They again sent Bosi Wuluban to say: "By the king's order, the king and the crown prince will come in person later."

sentences.zh: 」行省傳檄召之，官軍復駐城外。

translations.literal: The Branch Secretariat issued a summons, and the government army again encamped outside the city.
translations.idiomatic: The Branch Secretariat issued a summons, and the government army again encamped outside the city.

sentences.zh: 二十三日，遣其舅寶脫禿花等三十餘人，奉國王信物雜布二百匹、大銀三錠、小銀五十七錠、碎銀一甕為質，來歸款。

translations.literal: On the twenty-third day they sent the king's maternal uncle Baotuotuhua and more than thirty others, presenting as pledges the king's tokens: two hundred bolts of assorted cloth, three large silver ingots, fifty-seven small silver ingots, and one jar of broken silver, to come and submit.
translations.idiomatic: On the twenty-third they sent the king's maternal uncle Baotuotuhua and more than thirty others, presenting as pledges the king's tokens: two hundred bolts of assorted cloth, three large silver ingots, fifty-seven small silver ingots, and one jar of broken silver, to submit.

sentences.zh: 又獻金葉九節標槍曰：「國主欲來，病未能進，先使持其槍來，以見誠意。

translations.literal: They also presented a nine-jointed gold-leaf ceremonial spear, saying: "The king wishes to come but is ill and cannot advance. He first sends this spear to show sincerity."
translations.idiomatic: They also presented a nine-jointed gold-leaf ceremonial spear, saying: "The king wishes to come but is ill and cannot advance. He sends this spear first to show his sincerity."

sentences.zh: 長子補的期三日請見。

translations.literal: The eldest son Bude will request an audience within three days.
translations.idiomatic: The eldest son Bude will request an audience within three days.

sentences.zh: 」省官却其物。

translations.literal: The provincial officials refused the gifts.
translations.idiomatic: The provincial officials refused the gifts.

sentences.zh: 寶脫禿花曰：「不受，是薄之也。

translations.literal: Baotuotuhua said: "If you do not accept them, that is to treat us lightly."
translations.idiomatic: Baotuotuhua said: "If you do not accept them, that is to treat us lightly."

sentences.zh: 」行省度不可却，姑令收置，乃以上聞。

translations.literal: The Branch Secretariat judged that they could not be refused, and for the time being ordered them received and stored, then reported upward.
translations.idiomatic: The Branch Secretariat judged that the gifts could not be refused, ordered them received and stored for the time being, and reported upward.

sentences.zh: 寶脫禿花復令其主第四子利世麻八都八德剌、第五子世利印德剌來見，且言：「先有兵十萬，故求戰。

translations.literal: Baotuotuhua again had his lord's fourth son Lishimabadu Badera and fifth son Shiliyindela come to audience, saying: "We formerly had one hundred thousand troops, so we sought battle."
translations.idiomatic: Baotuotuhua again had his lord's fourth son Lishimabadu Badera and fifth son Shiliyindela come to audience, saying: "We formerly had one hundred thousand troops, so we sought battle."

sentences.zh: 今皆敗散。

translations.literal: Now they have all been defeated and scattered.
translations.idiomatic: Now they have all been defeated and scattered.

sentences.zh: 聞敗兵言，補的被傷已死。

translations.literal: According to defeated soldiers, Bude was wounded and has already died.
translations.idiomatic: According to defeated soldiers, Bude was wounded and has already died.

sentences.zh: 國主頰中箭，今小愈，愧懼未能見也，故先遣二子來議赴闕進見事。

translations.literal: The king was struck by an arrow in the cheek; he is now somewhat recovered but ashamed and fearful and unable to come to audience, so he first sends these two sons to discuss going to court.
translations.idiomatic: The king was struck by an arrow in the cheek; he is now somewhat recovered but ashamed and fearful and unable to come to audience, so he first sends these two sons to discuss going to court.

sentences.zh: 」省官疑其非真子，聽其還。

translations.literal: The provincial officials suspected they were not the true sons and allowed them to return.
translations.idiomatic: The provincial officials suspected they were not the true sons and allowed them to return.

sentences.zh: 諭國主早降，且以問疾為辭，遣千戶林子全、緫把栗全、李德堅偕往覘之。

translations.literal: They instructed the king to surrender early and, on the pretext of inquiring after his illness, dispatched Company Commander Lin Ziquan, Chief Company Commander Li Quan, and Li Dejian to go together and observe.
translations.idiomatic: They instructed the king to surrender early and, on the pretext of inquiring after his illness, dispatched Company Commander Lin Ziquan, Chief Company Commander Li Quan, and Li Dejian to go and observe.

sentences.zh: 二子在途先歸。

translations.literal: The two sons returned first on the road.
translations.idiomatic: The two sons returned first on the road.

sentences.zh: 子全等入山兩程，國主遣人來拒，不果見。

translations.literal: Ziquan and the others entered the mountains for two stages, but the king sent men to repel them and they failed to obtain an audience.
translations.idiomatic: Ziquan and the others entered the mountains for two stages, but the king sent men to repel them and they failed to obtain an audience.

sentences.zh: 寶脫禿花謂子全曰：「國主遷延不肯出降，今反揚言欲殺我，可歸告省官，來則來，不來，我當執以往。

translations.literal: Baotuotuhua said to Ziquan: "The king delays and refuses to come out and surrender. Now he even spreads word that he wants to kill me. You may return and tell the provincial officials: if he comes, he comes; if not, I shall seize him and bring him."
translations.idiomatic: Baotuotuhua said to Ziquan: "The king delays and refuses to surrender. Now he even spreads word that he wants to kill me. Return and tell the provincial officials: if he comes, he comes; if not, I shall seize him and bring him."

sentences.zh: 」子全等回營。

translations.literal: Ziquan and the others returned to camp.
translations.idiomatic: Ziquan and the others returned to camp.

sentences.zh: 是日，又殺何子志、皇甫傑等百餘人。

translations.literal: That same day they again killed He Zizhi, Huangfu Jie, and more than one hundred others.
translations.idiomatic: That same day they again killed He Zizhi, Huangfu Jie, and more than one hundred others.

sentences.zh: 二月八日，寶脫禿花又至，自言：「吾祖父、伯、叔，前皆為國主，至吾兄，今孛由補剌者吾殺而奪其位，斬我左右二大指。

translations.literal: On the eighth day of the second month, Baotuotuhua came again and said on his own behalf: "My grandfather, uncles, and elder uncles were all kings before. As for my elder brother, the present Jaya Indravarman, I killed him and seized his throne and had the two great fingers of my left and right hands cut off."
translations.idiomatic: On the eighth day of the second month, Baotuotuhua came again and said: "My grandfather, uncles, and elder uncles were all kings before. As for my elder brother, the present Jaya Indravarman, I killed him and seized his throne and had the two great fingers of my left and right hands cut off."

sentences.zh: 我實怨之。

translations.literal: I truly bear a grudge against him.
translations.idiomatic: I truly bear a grudge against him.

sentences.zh: 願禽孛由補剌者吾、補的父子，及大拔撒機兒以獻。

translations.literal: I wish to capture Jaya Indravarman and Bude, father and son, and the great Basajier and present them.
translations.idiomatic: I wish to capture Jaya Indravarman and Bude, father and son, and the great Basajier and present them to you.

sentences.zh: 請給大元服色。

translations.literal: I request to be granted Yuan court robes and insignia.
translations.idiomatic: I request to be granted Yuan court robes and insignia.

sentences.zh: 」行省賜衣冠，撫諭以行。

translations.literal: The Branch Secretariat granted robes and caps and sent him off with encouragement.
translations.idiomatic: The Branch Secretariat granted robes and caps and sent him off with encouragement.

sentences.zh: 十三日，居占城唐人曾延等來言：「國主逃於大州西北鴉候山，聚兵三千餘，并招集他郡兵未至，不日將與官軍交戰。

translations.literal: On the thirteenth day, Zeng Yan and other Chinese residents of Champa came and said: "The king has fled to Yahou Mountain northwest of the great district, gathered more than three thousand troops, and is also summoning troops from other districts that have not yet arrived. Before long he will engage the government army in battle."
translations.idiomatic: On the thirteenth, Zeng Yan and other Chinese residents of Champa came and said: "The king has fled to Yahou Mountain northwest of the great district, gathered more than three thousand troops, and is also summoning troops from other districts that have not yet arrived. Before long he will engage the government army in battle."

sentences.zh: 懼唐人泄其事，將盡殺之。

translations.literal: Fearing that the Chinese would leak the matter, he intends to kill them all.
translations.idiomatic: Fearing that the Chinese would leak the matter, he intends to kill them all.

sentences.zh: 延等覺而逃來。

translations.literal: Yan and the others discovered this and fled here.
translations.idiomatic: Yan and the others discovered this and fled here.

sentences.zh: 」十五日，寶脫禿花偕宰相報孫達兒及撮及大師等五人來降。

translations.literal: On the fifteenth day, Baotuotuhua together with the chancellor Baosundaer and Suoji Dashi and three others came to surrender.
translations.idiomatic: On the fifteenth, Baotuotuhua together with Chancellor Baosundaer and Suoji Dashi and three others came to surrender.

sentences.zh: 行省官引曾延等見，寶脫禿花詰之，曰：「延等姦細人也，請繫縲之。

translations.literal: The provincial officials brought Zeng Yan and the others to be seen. Baotuotuhua questioned them and said: "Yan and the others are spies. Please bind them."
translations.idiomatic: The provincial officials brought Zeng Yan and the others forward. Baotuotuhua questioned them and said: "Yan and the others are spies. Please bind them."

sentences.zh: 國主軍皆潰散，安敢復戰。

translations.literal: The king's army has all broken and scattered—how would they dare fight again?
translations.idiomatic: The king's army has all broken and scattered—how would they dare fight again?

sentences.zh: 」又言：「今未附州郡凡十二處，每州遣一人招之。

translations.literal: He also said: "There are twelve districts that have not yet submitted. Send one man to each district to summon them."
translations.idiomatic: He also said: "There are twelve districts that have not yet submitted. Send one man to each district to summon them."

sentences.zh: 舊州水路，乞行省與陳安撫及寶脫禿花各遣一人乘舟招諭攻取。

translations.literal: For the water route to Jiuzhou, I ask that the Branch Secretariat, Pacification Commissioner Chen, and Baotuotuhua each send one man by boat to summon and seize it.
translations.idiomatic: For the water route to Jiuzhou, I ask that the Branch Secretariat, Pacification Commissioner Chen, and Baotuotuhua each send one man by boat to summon and seize it.

sentences.zh: 陸路則乞行省官陳安撫與己往禽國主、補的及攻其城。

translations.literal: For the land route, I ask that the provincial officials, Pacification Commissioner Chen, and I go to capture the king, Bude, and attack their city.
translations.idiomatic: For the land route, I ask that the provincial officials, Pacification Commissioner Chen, and I go to capture the king, Bude, and attack their city.

sentences.zh: 」行省猶信其言，調兵一千屯半山塔，遣子全、德堅等領軍百人，與寶脫禿花同赴大州進討，約有急則報半山軍。

translations.literal: The Branch Secretariat still believed his words, transferred one thousand troops to garrison at Banshanta, and dispatched Ziquan, Dejian, and others leading one hundred troops to advance with Baotuotuhua to the great district, agreeing that if there was urgency they would report to the Banshan troops.
translations.idiomatic: The Branch Secretariat still believed him, transferred one thousand troops to garrison at Banshanta, and dispatched Ziquan, Dejian, and others with one hundred troops to advance with Baotuotuhua to the great district, agreeing to report to the Banshan troops if there was urgency.

sentences.zh: 子全等比至城西，寶脫禿花背約間行，自北門乘象遁入山。

translations.literal: When Ziquan and the others reached the west of the city, Baotuotuhua broke the agreement and slipped away, riding an elephant out the north gate and escaping into the mountains.
translations.idiomatic: When Ziquan and the others reached the west of the city, Baotuotuhua broke the agreement and slipped away, riding an elephant out the north gate and escaping into the mountains.

sentences.zh: 官軍獲諜者曰：「國主實在鴉候山立寨，聚兵約二萬餘，遣使交趾、真臘、闍婆等國借兵，及徵賓多龍、舊州等軍未至。

translations.literal: The government army captured a spy who said: "The king is indeed encamped at Yahou Mountain, gathering about twenty thousand troops, sending envoys to Jiaozhi, Zhenla, Java, and other countries to borrow troops, and summoning troops from Binduolong, Jiuzhou, and elsewhere that have not yet arrived."
translations.idiomatic: The government army captured a spy who said: "The king is indeed encamped at Yahou Mountain, gathering about twenty thousand troops, sending envoys to Jiaozhi, Zhenla, Java, and other countries to borrow troops, and summoning troops from Binduolong, Jiuzhou, and elsewhere that have not yet arrived."

sentences.zh: 」十六日，遣萬戶張顒等領兵赴國主所棲之境。

translations.literal: On the sixteenth day they dispatched Ten-thousand-household Commander Zhang Yong and others leading troops to the region where the king had taken refuge.
translations.idiomatic: On the sixteenth they dispatched Ten-thousand-household Commander Zhang Yong and others with troops to the region where the king had taken refuge.

sentences.zh: 十九日，顒兵近木城二十里。

translations.literal: On the nineteenth day Yong's troops came within twenty li of the wooden wall.
translations.idiomatic: On the nineteenth Yong's troops came within twenty li of the wooden wall.

sentences.zh: 賊浚濠塹，拒以大木，官軍斬刈超距奮擊，破其二千餘衆。

translations.literal: The enemy dug moats and ditches and blocked with great logs. The government army cut through, crossed the distance, and struck fiercely, breaking more than two thousand of the enemy.
translations.idiomatic: The enemy dug moats and ditches and blocked the way with great logs. The government army cut through, closed the distance, and struck fiercely, breaking more than two thousand of the enemy.

sentences.zh: 轉戰至木城下，山林阻隘不能進，賊旁出截歸路，軍皆殊死戰，遂得解還營。

translations.literal: Fighting on, they reached below the wooden wall, but mountains and forests blocked the narrow passes and they could not advance. The enemy swept out from the side and cut off the return route. The army all fought to the death and thus managed to break free and return to camp.
translations.idiomatic: Fighting on, they reached below the wooden wall, but mountains and forests blocked the narrow passes and they could not advance. The enemy swept out from the side and cut off the return route. The army fought to the death and managed to break free and return to camp.

sentences.zh: 行省遂整軍聚糧，創木城，遣緫管劉金，千戶劉涓、岳榮守禦。

translations.literal: The Branch Secretariat then reorganized the army, gathered provisions, built a wooden wall, and dispatched Administrator Liu Jin and Company Commanders Liu Juan and Yue Rong to defend it.
translations.idiomatic: The Branch Secretariat then reorganized the army, gathered provisions, built a wooden wall, and dispatched Administrator Liu Jin and Company Commanders Liu Juan and Yue Rong to defend it.

sentences.zh: 二十一年三月六日，唆都領軍回。

translations.literal: On the sixth day of the third month of the twenty-first year, Suodu led the army back.
translations.idiomatic: On the sixth day of the third month of the twenty-first year, Suodu led the army back.

sentences.zh: 十五日，江淮省所遣助唆都軍萬戶忽都虎等至占城唆都舊制行省舒眉蓮港，見營舍燒盡，始知官軍已回。

translations.literal: On the fifteenth day, Hudu Hu and others, Ten-thousand-household Commanders of the troops sent by the Jianghuai Branch Secretariat to assist Suodu, reached Shumeilian Harbor in Champa where Suodu's former Branch Secretariat had been, saw the camps burned to the ground, and only then learned that the government army had already withdrawn.
translations.idiomatic: On the fifteenth, Hudu Hu and others, ten-thousand-household commanders of the troops sent by the Jianghuai Branch Secretariat to assist Suodu, reached Shumeilian Harbor in Champa where Suodu's former Branch Secretariat had been, saw the camps burned to the ground, and only then learned that the government army had already withdrawn.

sentences.zh: 二十日，忽都虎令百戶陳奎招其國主來降。

translations.literal: On the twentieth day, Hudu Hu ordered Company Commander Chen Kui to summon the king to surrender.
translations.idiomatic: On the twentieth, Hudu Hu ordered Company Commander Chen Kui to summon the king to surrender.

sentences.zh: 二十七日，占城主遣王通事者來稱納降。

translations.literal: On the twenty-seventh day, the king of Champa sent a royal interpreter to declare submission.
translations.idiomatic: On the twenty-seventh, the king of Champa sent a royal interpreter to declare submission.

sentences.zh: 忽都虎等諭令其父子奉表進獻。

translations.literal: Hudu Hu and the others instructed them to present a memorial and tribute, father and son together.
translations.idiomatic: Hudu Hu and the others instructed them to present a memorial and tribute, father and son together.

sentences.zh: 國主遣文勞邛大巴南等來稱，唆都除蕩其國，貧無以獻，來年當備禮物，令嫡子入朝。

translations.literal: The king sent Wenlaoqiong Daban and others to say that Suodu had devastated their country, they were too poor to present gifts, and next year they would prepare tribute and send the son by the principal consort to court.
translations.idiomatic: The king sent Wenlaoqiong Daban and others to say that Suodu had devastated their country, they were too poor to present gifts, and next year they would prepare tribute and send the son by the principal consort to court.

sentences.zh: 四月十二日，國主令其孫濟目理勒蟄、文勞邛大巴南等奉表歸款。

translations.literal: On the twelfth day of the fourth month, the king had his grandson Jimulilezhe, Wenlaoqiong Daban, and others present a memorial of submission.
translations.idiomatic: On the twelfth day of the fourth month, the king had his grandson Jimulilezhe, Wenlaoqiong Daban, and others present a memorial of submission.

sentences.zh: 是年，命平章政事阿里海牙奉鎮南王脫歡發兵，假道交趾伐占城，不果行。

translations.literal: That year, Grand Councillor Ali Haiya was ordered to accompany Prince Togan of Zhennan in raising troops to campaign against Champa by way of Jiaozhi, but the expedition did not take place.
translations.idiomatic: That year, Grand Councillor Ali Haiya was ordered to accompany Prince Togan of Zhennan in raising troops to campaign against Champa by way of Jiaozhi, but the expedition did not take place.

sentences.zh: 暹國，當成宗元貞元年，進金字表，欲朝廷遣使至其國。

translations.literal: Siam: in the first year of the Yuanzhen era of Emperor Chengzong, it presented a memorial written in gold characters, requesting that the court send envoys to its country.
translations.idiomatic: Siam: in the first Yuanzhen year of Emperor Chengzong, it presented a memorial written in gold characters, requesting that the court send envoys to its country.

sentences.zh: 比其表至，已先遣使，蓋彼未之知也。

translations.literal: By the time its memorial arrived, envoys had already been dispatched—they had not known of this.
translations.idiomatic: By the time its memorial arrived, envoys had already been dispatched—they had not known of this.

sentences.zh: 賜來使素金符佩之，使急追詔使同往。

translations.literal: The arriving envoy was granted a plain gold tally to wear and ordered to hurry after the imperial envoy and go together.
translations.idiomatic: The arriving envoy was granted a plain gold tally to wear and ordered to hurry after the imperial envoy and go together.

sentences.zh: 以暹人與麻里予兒舊相讎殺，至是皆歸順，有旨諭暹人「勿傷麻里予兒，以踐爾言」。

translations.literal: Because the Siamese and the Malai'er had formerly killed one another in feud, and now both had submitted, an edict instructed the Siamese: "Do not harm the Malai'er, to fulfill your word."
translations.idiomatic: Because the Siamese and the Malai'er had formerly killed one another in feud, and now both had submitted, an edict instructed the Siamese: "Do not harm the Malai'er, to fulfill your word."

sentences.zh: 大德三年，暹國主上言，其父在位時，朝廷嘗賜鞍轡、白馬及金縷衣，乞循舊例以賜。

translations.literal: In the third year of Dade, the king of Siam memorialized that when his father was on the throne the court had once granted saddle and bridle, a white horse, and gold-thread robes, and he requested that the old precedent be followed in granting them.
translations.idiomatic: In the third Dade year, the king of Siam memorialized that when his father was on the throne the court had once granted saddle and bridle, a white horse, and gold-thread robes, and he requested that the old precedent be followed.

sentences.zh: 帝以丞相完澤荅剌罕言「彼小國而賜以馬，恐其鄰忻都輩譏議朝廷」，仍賜金縷衣，不賜以馬。

translations.literal: The emperor, on Chancellor Oqor Taghai's advice that "to grant a horse to so small a country might invite mockery of the court from neighboring Xindu and the like," still granted gold-thread robes but did not grant a horse.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor, on Chancellor Oqor Taghai's advice that granting a horse to so small a country might invite mockery from neighboring Xindu and the like, still granted gold-thread robes but did not grant a horse.

sentences.zh: 爪哇在海外，視占城益遠。

translations.literal: Java lies overseas, even farther than Champa.
translations.idiomatic: Java lies overseas, even farther from China than Champa.

sentences.zh: 自泉南登舟海行者，先至占城而後至其國。

translations.literal: For those who embark by sea from Quannan, they reach Champa first and then arrive at that country.
translations.idiomatic: For those who embark by sea from Quannan, they reach Champa first and then arrive at Java.

sentences.zh: 其風俗土產不可考，大率海外諸蕃國多出奇寶，取貴於中國，而其人則醜怪，情性語言與中國不能相通。

translations.literal: Its customs and local products cannot be fully verified. Generally the various maritime barbarian countries produce many rare treasures prized in China, while their people are ugly and strange, and their dispositions and languages cannot communicate with China.
translations.idiomatic: Its customs and local products cannot be fully verified. Generally the various maritime countries produce many rare treasures prized in China, while their people are regarded as strange in appearance, and their dispositions and languages are unintelligible to China.

sentences.zh: 世祖撫有四夷，其出師海外諸蕃者，惟爪哇之役為大。

translations.literal: Emperor Shizu pacified the four barbarian quarters, and among campaigns to the various maritime countries overseas, only the Java expedition was on the largest scale.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Shizu pacified the four quarters, and among campaigns to the various maritime countries overseas, only the Java expedition was on the largest scale.

sentences.zh: 至元二十九年二月，詔福建行省除史弼、亦黑迷失、高興平章政事，征爪哇；

translations.literal: In the second month of the twenty-ninth year of Zhiyuan, an edict appointed Shi Bi, Yiqimishi, and Gao Xing as Grand Councillors of the Fujian Branch Secretariat to campaign against Java.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of the twenty-ninth Zhiyuan year, an edict appointed Shi Bi, Yiqimishi, and Gao Xing as Grand Councillors of the Fujian Branch Secretariat to campaign against Java.

sentences.zh: 會福建、江西、湖廣三行省兵凡二萬，設左右軍都元帥府二、征行上萬戶四，發舟千艘，給糧一年、鈔四萬錠，降虎符十、金符四十、銀符百、金衣段百端，用備功賞。

translations.literal: They assembled twenty thousand troops from the three Branch Secretariats of Fujian, Jiangxi, and Huguang, established two Left and Right Army Grand Marshal's headquarters and four Campaign Upper Ten-thousand-household Commands, dispatched one thousand boats, supplied one year's grain and forty thousand ding of paper money, and granted ten tiger tallies, forty gold tallies, one hundred silver tallies, and one hundred bolts of gold brocade for rewarding merit.
translations.idiomatic: They assembled twenty thousand troops from the Fujian, Jiangxi, and Huguang Branch Secretariats, established two Left and Right Army Grand Marshal's headquarters and four Campaign Upper Ten-thousand-household Commands, dispatched one thousand boats, supplied one year's grain and forty thousand ding of paper money, and granted ten tiger tallies, forty gold tallies, one hundred silver tallies, and one hundred bolts of gold brocade for rewarding merit.

sentences.zh: 亦黑迷失等陛辭。

translations.literal: Yiqimishi and the others took leave at court.
translations.idiomatic: Yiqimishi and the others took leave at court.

sentences.zh: 帝曰：「卿等至爪哇，明告其國軍民，朝廷初與爪哇通使往來交好，後刺詔使孟右丞之面，以此進討。

translations.literal: The emperor said: "When you reach Java, clearly inform its soldiers and people that the court initially exchanged envoys with Java in friendship, but later they slashed the face of the imperial envoy Vice Chancellor Meng—therefore this punitive advance."
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said: "When you reach Java, clearly inform its soldiers and people that the court initially exchanged envoys with Java in friendship, but later they slashed the face of the imperial envoy Vice Chancellor Meng—therefore this punitive advance."

sentences.zh: 」九月，軍會慶元。

translations.literal: In the ninth month the army assembled at Qingyuan.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month the army assembled at Qingyuan.

sentences.zh: 弼、亦黑迷失領省事，赴泉州；

translations.literal: Bi and Yiqimishi led the provincial affairs and went to Quanzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Bi and Yiqimishi led the provincial affairs and went to Quanzhou.

sentences.zh: 興率輜重自慶元登舟涉海。

translations.literal: Xing led the baggage train, embarked at Qingyuan, and crossed the sea.
translations.idiomatic: Xing led the baggage train, embarked at Qingyuan, and crossed the sea.

sentences.zh: 十一月，福建、江西、湖廣三省軍會泉州。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month the armies of the three provinces of Fujian, Jiangxi, and Huguang assembled at Quanzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month the armies of Fujian, Jiangxi, and Huguang assembled at Quanzhou.

sentences.zh: 十二月，自後渚啟行。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month they set out from Houzhu.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month they set out from Houzhu.

sentences.zh: 三十年正月，至構欄山議方略。

translations.literal: In the first month of the thirtieth year they reached Goulanshan to discuss strategy.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the thirtieth year they reached Goulanshan to discuss strategy.

sentences.zh: 二月，亦黑迷失、孫參政先領本省幕官并招諭爪哇等處宣慰司官曲出海牙、楊梓、全忠祖，萬戶張塔剌赤等五百餘人，船十艘，先往招諭之。

translations.literal: In the second month, Yiqimishi and Vice Administrator Sun first led more than five hundred men including provincial staff officials and Pacification Commissioners of Java and other places Qu Chuhaiya, Yang Zi, and Quan Zhongzu, and Company Commander Zhang Talachi, with ten boats, to go ahead and summon them.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, Yiqimishi and Vice Administrator Sun first led more than five hundred men including provincial staff and Pacification Commissioners of Java and other places Qu Chuhaiya, Yang Zi, and Quan Zhongzu, and Company Commander Zhang Talachi, with ten boats, to go ahead and summon them.

sentences.zh: 大軍繼進於吉利門。

translations.literal: The main army followed and advanced to Jilimen.
translations.idiomatic: The main army followed and advanced to Jilimen.

sentences.zh: 弼、興進至爪哇之杜並足，與亦黑迷失等議，分軍下岸，水陸並進。

translations.literal: Bi and Xing advanced to Dubingzu in Java, consulted with Yiqimishi and the others, divided the army to go ashore, and advanced by land and water together.
translations.idiomatic: Bi and Xing advanced to Dubingzu in Java, consulted with Yiqimishi and the others, divided the army to go ashore, and advanced by land and water together.

sentences.zh: 弼與孫參政帥都元帥那海、萬戶寗居仁等水軍，自杜並足由戎牙路港口至八節澗。

translations.literal: Bi and Vice Administrator Sun commanded Grand Marshal Naihai, Company Commander Ning Juren, and the naval forces from Dubingzu by way of the port of Rongyalu to Bajiejian.
translations.idiomatic: Bi and Vice Administrator Sun commanded Grand Marshal Naihai, Company Commander Ning Juren, and the naval forces from Dubingzu by way of the port of Rongyalu to Bajiejian.

sentences.zh: 興與亦黑迷失帥都元帥鄭鎮國、萬戶脫歡等馬步軍，自杜並足陸行。

translations.literal: Xing and Yiqimishi commanded Grand Marshal Zheng Zhenguo, Company Commander Tuohuan, and the cavalry and infantry from Dubingzu by land.
translations.idiomatic: Xing and Yiqimishi commanded Grand Marshal Zheng Zhenguo, Company Commander Tuohuan, and the cavalry and infantry from Dubingzu by land.

sentences.zh: 以萬戶申元為前鋒。

translations.literal: Company Commander Shen Yuan was made vanguard.
translations.idiomatic: Company Commander Shen Yuan was made vanguard.

sentences.zh: 遣副元帥土虎登哥，萬戶褚懷遠、李忠等乘鑽鋒船，由戎牙路，於麻喏巴歇浮梁前進，赴八節澗期會。

translations.literal: Deputy Marshal Tuhudengge, Company Commanders Chu Huaiyuan and Li Zhong, and others were sent in drill-prowed boats by way of Rongyalu, advancing before the pontoon bridge at Manobaxi to meet at Bajiejian on schedule.
translations.idiomatic: Deputy Marshal Tuhudengge, Company Commanders Chu Huaiyuan and Li Zhong, and others were sent in drill-prowed boats by way of Rongyalu, advancing before the pontoon bridge at Manobaxi to rendezvous at Bajiejian.

sentences.zh: 招諭爪哇宣撫司官言：爪哇主壻土罕必闍耶舉國納降，土罕必闍耶不能離軍，先令楊梓、甘州不花、全忠祖引其宰相昔剌難荅吒耶等五十餘人來迎。

translations.literal: The Pacification Commissioner of Java who was summoned reported: the king's son-in-law Tuhannabaya had submitted the whole country. Tuhannabaya could not leave the army and first had Yang Zi, Ganzhou Buhua, and Quan Zhongzu lead more than fifty of his chancellors, including Xilanandazhaye, to come and welcome them.
translations.idiomatic: The Pacification Commissioner of Java who was summoned reported that the king's son-in-law Tuhannabaya had submitted the whole country. Unable to leave the army, Tuhannabaya first had Yang Zi, Ganzhou Buhua, and Quan Zhongzu lead more than fifty of his chancellors, including Xilanandazhaye, to welcome them.

sentences.zh: 三月一日，會軍八節澗。

translations.literal: On the first day of the third month the armies joined at Bajiejian.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the third month the armies joined at Bajiejian.

sentences.zh: 澗上接杜馬班王府，下通莆奔大海，乃爪哇咽喉必爭之地。
