translations.literal: Upstream the stream connects to the princely residence of Tumapan; downstream it opens to the great sea at Puben—it is the strategic throat of Java that must be contested.
translations.idiomatic: Upstream the stream connects to the princely residence of Tumapan; downstream it opens to the great sea at Puben—it is the strategic throat of Java that must be contested.

sentences.zh: 又其謀臣希寧官沿河泊舟，觀望成敗，再三招諭不降。

translations.literal: Moreover, his counselor Xiningguan moored boats along the river, watching the outcome, and despite repeated summons would not submit.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover, his counselor Xiningguan moored boats along the river, watching the outcome, and despite repeated summons would not submit.

sentences.zh: 行省於澗邊設偃月營，留萬戶王天祥守河津，土虎登哥、李忠等領水軍，鄭鎮國、省都鎮撫倫信等領馬步軍水陸並進。

translations.literal: The Branch Secretariat set up a crescent camp by the stream, left Company Commander Wang Tianxiang to guard the river crossing, and had Tuhudengge, Li Zhong, and others lead the navy while Zheng Zhenguo, Provincial Chief Pacification Commissioner Lunxin, and others led cavalry and infantry advancing together by land and water.
translations.idiomatic: The Branch Secretariat set up a crescent camp by the stream, left Company Commander Wang Tianxiang to guard the river crossing, and had Tuhudengge, Li Zhong, and others lead the navy while Zheng Zhenguo, Provincial Chief Pacification Commissioner Lunxin, and others led cavalry and infantry advancing together by land and water.

sentences.zh: 希寧官懼，棄船宵遁，獲鬼頭大船百餘艘。

translations.literal: Xiningguan was afraid, abandoned his boats and fled by night, and more than one hundred large prowed ships were captured.
translations.idiomatic: Xiningguan was afraid, abandoned his boats and fled by night, and more than one hundred large prowed ships were captured.

sentences.zh: 令都元帥那海、萬戶寗居仁、鄭珪、高德誠、張受等鎮八節澗海口。

translations.literal: Grand Marshal Naihai, Company Commanders Ning Juren, Zheng Gui, Gao Decheng, and Zhang Shou and others were ordered to garrison the mouth of Bajiejian.
translations.idiomatic: Grand Marshal Naihai, Company Commanders Ning Juren, Zheng Gui, Gao Decheng, and Zhang Shou and others were ordered to garrison the mouth of Bajiejian.

sentences.zh: 大軍方進，土罕必闍耶遣使來告，葛郎王追殺至麻喏巴歇，請官軍救之。

translations.literal: As the main army was advancing, Tuhannabaya sent envoys to report that the king of Gelang was pursuing and killing as far as Manobaxi, and requested the government army to rescue him.
translations.idiomatic: As the main army was advancing, Tuhannabaya sent envoys to report that the king of Gelang was pursuing him as far as Manobaxi and requested government troops to rescue him.

sentences.zh: 亦黑迷失、張參政先往安慰土罕必闍耶，鄭鎮國引軍赴章孤接援。

translations.literal: Yiqimishi and Vice Administrator Zhang went first to reassure Tuhannabaya, and Zheng Zhenguo led troops to Zhanggu to provide support.
translations.idiomatic: Yiqimishi and Vice Administrator Zhang went first to reassure Tuhannabaya, and Zheng Zhenguo led troops to Zhanggu to provide support.

sentences.zh: 興進至麻喏巴歇，却稱葛郎兵未知遠近，興回八節澗。

translations.literal: Xing advanced to Manobaxi but then said the Gelang troops' distance was unknown, and Xing returned to Bajiejian.
translations.idiomatic: Xing advanced to Manobaxi but then said the Gelang troops' whereabouts were unknown and returned to Bajiejian.

sentences.zh: 亦黑迷失尋報賊兵今夜當至，召興赴麻喏巴歇。

translations.literal: Yiqimishi soon reported that enemy troops would arrive that night and summoned Xing to Manobaxi.
translations.idiomatic: Yiqimishi soon reported that enemy troops would arrive that night and summoned Xing to Manobaxi.

sentences.zh: 七日，葛郎兵三路攻土罕必闍耶。

translations.literal: On the seventh day, Gelang troops attacked Tuhannabaya in three columns.
translations.idiomatic: On the seventh day, Gelang troops attacked Tuhannabaya in three columns.

sentences.zh: 八日黎明，亦黑迷失、孫參政率萬戶李明迎賊於西南，不遇。

translations.literal: At dawn on the eighth day, Yiqimishi and Vice Administrator Sun led Company Commander Li Ming to meet the enemy in the southwest but did not encounter them.
translations.idiomatic: At dawn on the eighth day, Yiqimishi and Vice Administrator Sun led Company Commander Li Ming to meet the enemy in the southwest but did not encounter them.

sentences.zh: 興與脫歡由東南路與賊戰，殺數百人，餘奔潰山谷。

translations.literal: Xing and Tuohuan fought the enemy by the southeast route, killed several hundred men, and the rest fled in rout into the valleys.
translations.idiomatic: Xing and Tuohuan fought the enemy by the southeast route, killed several hundred men, and the rest fled in rout into the valleys.

sentences.zh: 日中，西南路賊又至，興再戰至晡，又敗之。

translations.literal: At midday enemy troops on the southwest route arrived again. Xing fought again until the hour of shen and once more defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: At midday enemy troops on the southwest route arrived again. Xing fought again until late afternoon and once more defeated them.

sentences.zh: 十五日，分軍為三道伐葛郎，期十九日會荅哈，聽砲聲接戰。

translations.literal: On the fifteenth day they divided the army into three columns to campaign against Gelang, set the nineteenth for rendezvous at Daha, and agreed to join battle on hearing cannon fire.
translations.idiomatic: On the fifteenth they divided the army into three columns to campaign against Gelang, set the nineteenth for rendezvous at Daha, and agreed to join battle on hearing cannon fire.

sentences.zh: 土虎登哥等水軍泝流而上，亦黑迷失等由西道，興等由東道進，土罕必闍耶軍繼其後。

translations.literal: Tuhudengge and the navy went upstream; Yiqimishi and others took the western route; Xing and others advanced by the eastern route; and Tuhannabaya's army followed behind.
translations.idiomatic: Tuhudengge and the navy went upstream; Yiqimishi and others took the western route; Xing and others advanced by the eastern route; and Tuhannabaya's army followed behind.

sentences.zh: 十九日，至荅哈。

translations.literal: On the nineteenth day they reached Daha.
translations.idiomatic: On the nineteenth they reached Daha.

sentences.zh: 葛郎國主以兵十餘萬交戰，自卯至未，連三戰，賊敗奔潰，擁入河死者數萬人，殺五千餘人。

translations.literal: The king of Gelang fought with more than one hundred thousand troops. From the hour of mao to the hour of wei they fought three battles in succession. The enemy were defeated and fled in rout; tens of thousands were crushed into the river and drowned, and more than five thousand were killed.
translations.idiomatic: The king of Gelang fought with more than one hundred thousand troops. From dawn to mid-afternoon they fought three battles in succession. The enemy were routed; tens of thousands were crushed into the river and drowned, and more than five thousand were killed.

sentences.zh: 國主入內城拒守，官軍圍之，且招其降。

translations.literal: The king entered the inner city to hold out. The government army besieged it and also summoned him to surrender.
translations.idiomatic: The king entered the inner city to hold out. The government army besieged it and summoned him to surrender.

sentences.zh: 是夕，國主哈只葛當出降，撫諭令還。

translations.literal: That evening the king, Hajigedang, came out and surrendered. They reassured him and sent him back.
translations.idiomatic: That evening the king, Hajigedang, came out and surrendered. They reassured him and sent him back.

sentences.zh: 四月二日，遣土罕必闍耶還其地，具入貢禮，以萬戶捏只不丁、甘州不花率兵二百護送。

translations.literal: On the second day of the fourth month they sent Tuhannabaya back to his territory with tribute gifts prepared, escorted by Company Commanders Niezhibuding and Ganzhou Buhua leading two hundred troops.
translations.idiomatic: On the second day of the fourth month they sent Tuhannabaya back to his territory with tribute gifts prepared, escorted by Company Commanders Niezhibuding and Ganzhou Buhua with two hundred troops.

sentences.zh: 十九日，土罕必闍耶背叛逃去，留軍拒戰。

translations.literal: On the nineteenth day Tuhannabaya rebelled and fled, leaving troops to resist.
translations.idiomatic: On the nineteenth Tuhannabaya rebelled and fled, leaving troops to resist.

sentences.zh: 捏只不丁、甘州不花、省掾馮祥皆遇害。

translations.literal: Niezhibuding, Ganzhou Buhua, and Provincial Clerk Feng Xiang were all killed.
translations.idiomatic: Niezhibuding, Ganzhou Buhua, and Provincial Clerk Feng Xiang were all killed.

sentences.zh: 二十四日，軍還。

translations.literal: On the twenty-fourth day the army returned.
translations.idiomatic: On the twenty-fourth the army returned.

sentences.zh: 得哈只葛當妻子官屬百餘人，及地圖戶籍、所上金字表以還。

translations.literal: They took more than one hundred of Hajigedang's wife, children, and officials, along with territorial maps, household registers, and the gold-character memorial he had submitted, and returned.
translations.idiomatic: They took more than one hundred of Hajigedang's wife, children, and officials, along with territorial maps, household registers, and the gold-character memorial he had submitted, and returned.

sentences.zh: 事見史弼、高興傳。

translations.literal: The affair is recorded in the biographies of Shi Bi and Gao Xing.
translations.idiomatic: The affair is recorded in the biographies of Shi Bi and Gao Xing.

sentences.zh: 琉求，在南海之東。

translations.literal: Liuqiu lies to the east in the South Sea.
translations.idiomatic: Liuqiu lies in the South Sea to the east.

sentences.zh: 漳、泉、興、福四州界內彭湖諸島，與琉求相對，亦素不通。

translations.literal: The Peng-hu islands within the boundaries of the four prefectures of Zhang, Quan, Xing, and Fu face Liuqiu across the sea and likewise had never had contact.
translations.idiomatic: The Penghu islands within the boundaries of the four prefectures of Zhang, Quan, Xing, and Fu face Liuqiu across the sea and likewise had never had contact.

sentences.zh: 天氣清明時，望之隱約若煙若霧，其遠不知幾千里也。

translations.literal: When the weather is clear, looking toward it one sees it faintly like smoke or mist; its distance is unknown, perhaps several thousand li.
translations.idiomatic: When the weather is clear, it appears faintly like smoke or mist in the distance; how far away it lies is unknown, perhaps several thousand li.

sentences.zh: 西南北岸皆水，至彭湖漸低，近琉求則謂之落漈，漈者水趨下而不回也。

translations.literal: The southwest and north shores are all water. Approaching Penghu the land gradually lowers; near Liuqiu it is called Luoji. Ji means water rushing downward without returning.
translations.idiomatic: The southwest and north shores are all water. Approaching Penghu the land gradually lowers; near Liuqiu it is called Luoji—water rushing downward without returning.

sentences.zh: 凡西岸漁舟到彭湖已下，遇颶風發作，漂流落漈，回者百一。

translations.literal: Whenever fishing boats from the western shore reach below Penghu and encounter a typhoon, they drift into Luoji; only one in a hundred returns.
translations.idiomatic: Whenever fishing boats from the western shore reach below Penghu and encounter a typhoon, they drift into Luoji; only one in a hundred returns.

sentences.zh: 琉求，在外夷最小而險者也。

translations.literal: Liuqiu is among the foreign peoples the smallest and most perilous.
translations.idiomatic: Liuqiu is among the foreign peoples the smallest and most perilous.

sentences.zh: 漢、唐以來，史所不載，近代諸蕃市舶不聞至其國。

translations.literal: From Han and Tang onward it is not recorded in history, and in recent times no merchant ships of the various maritime countries are known to have reached it.
translations.idiomatic: From Han and Tang onward it is not recorded in history, and in recent times no merchant ships of the various maritime countries are known to have reached it.

sentences.zh: 世祖至元二十八年九月，海船副萬戶楊祥請以六千軍往降之，不聽命則遂伐之，朝廷從其請。

translations.literal: In the ninth month of the twenty-eighth year of Zhiyuan of Emperor Shizu, Yang Xiang, Deputy Ten-thousand-household Commander of the Sea Fleet, requested to lead six thousand troops to go and win its submission, and if it did not obey then to campaign against it. The court granted his request.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month of the twenty-eighth Zhiyuan year of Emperor Shizu, Yang Xiang, Deputy Ten-thousand-household Commander of the Sea Fleet, requested to lead six thousand troops to win its submission, and if it did not obey, to campaign against it. The court granted his request.

sentences.zh: 繼有書生吳志斗者上言生長福建，熟知海道利病，以為若欲收附，且就彭湖發船往諭，相水勢地利，然後興兵未晚也。

translations.literal: Subsequently a scholar, Wu Zhidou, memorialized that having grown up in Fujian he knew well the advantages and hazards of the sea routes, and held that if one wished to win submission, one should first dispatch boats from Penghu to instruct them, assess water conditions and terrain, and then raise troops—it would not be too late.
translations.idiomatic: Subsequently a scholar, Wu Zhidou, memorialized that having grown up in Fujian he knew well the advantages and hazards of the sea routes, and held that if one wished to win submission, one should first dispatch boats from Penghu to instruct them, assess water conditions and terrain, and then raise troops—it would not be too late.

sentences.zh: 冬十月，乃命楊祥充宣撫使，給金符，吳志斗禮部員外郎，阮鑒兵部員外郎，並給銀符，往使琉求。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter they appointed Yang Xiang Pacification Commissioner and granted a gold tally; Wu Zhidou was made Vice Director of the Ministry of Rites and Ruan Jian Vice Director of the Ministry of War, both granted silver tallies, and sent as envoys to Liuqiu.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter they appointed Yang Xiang Pacification Commissioner and granted a gold tally; Wu Zhidou was made Vice Director of the Ministry of Rites and Ruan Jian Vice Director of the Ministry of War, both granted silver tallies, and sent as envoys to Liuqiu.

sentences.zh: 詔曰：「收撫江南已十七年，海外諸蕃罔不臣屬。

translations.literal: An edict said: "In pacifying the Jiangnan region it has already been seventeen years, and none of the various maritime countries overseas has failed to submit."
translations.idiomatic: An edict said: "In pacifying the Jiangnan region it has already been seventeen years, and none of the various maritime countries overseas has failed to submit."

sentences.zh: 惟琉求邇閩境，未曾歸附。

translations.literal: Only Liuqiu, close to the Fujian border, has never submitted.
translations.idiomatic: Only Liuqiu, close to the Fujian border, has never submitted.

sentences.zh: 議者請即加兵。

translations.literal: Those who deliberated requested that troops be sent immediately.
translations.idiomatic: Those who deliberated requested that troops be sent immediately.

sentences.zh: 朕惟祖宗立法，凡不庭之國，先遣使招諭，來則按堵如故，否則必致征討。

translations.literal: I consider that according to the law established by our ancestors, for any country that does not come to court, envoys are first sent to summon and instruct them: if they come, they are left in peace as before; if not, a punitive expedition must follow.
translations.idiomatic: I consider that according to the law established by our ancestors, for any country that does not come to court, envoys are first sent to summon and instruct them: if they come, they are left in peace as before; if not, a punitive expedition must follow.

sentences.zh: 今止其兵，命楊祥、阮鑒往諭汝國。

translations.literal: Now I halt the troops and order Yang Xiang and Ruan Jian to go and instruct your country.
translations.idiomatic: Now I halt the troops and order Yang Xiang and Ruan Jian to go and instruct your country.

sentences.zh: 果能慕義來朝，存爾國祀，保爾黎庶；

translations.literal: If you can truly admire righteousness and come to court, your state's sacrifices will be preserved and your people protected.
translations.idiomatic: If you can truly admire righteousness and come to court, your state's sacrifices will be preserved and your people protected.

sentences.zh: 若不效順，自恃險阻，舟師奄及，恐貽後悔。

translations.literal: If you do not submit and instead rely on perilous terrain, when the fleet suddenly arrives you will likely regret it.
translations.idiomatic: If you do not submit and instead rely on perilous terrain, when the fleet suddenly arrives you will likely regret it.

sentences.zh: 爾其慎擇之。」

translations.literal: Choose carefully."
translations.idiomatic: Choose carefully."

sentences.zh: 二十九年三月二十九日，自汀路尾澳舟行，至是日巳時，海洋中正東望見有山長而低者，約去五十里。

translations.literal: On the twenty-ninth day of the third month of the twenty-ninth year, they set out by boat from Wei'ao in Ting Circuit. At the hour of si that day, looking due east across the ocean they saw a long, low mountain about fifty li away.
translations.idiomatic: On the twenty-ninth day of the third month of the twenty-ninth year, they set out by boat from Wei'ao in Ting Circuit. At the hour of si that day, looking due east across the ocean they saw a long, low mountain about fifty li away.

sentences.zh: 祥稱是琉求國，鑒稱不知的否。

translations.literal: Xiang said it was the country of Liuqiu; Jian said he did not know whether that was certain.
translations.idiomatic: Xiang said it was Liuqiu; Jian said he did not know whether that was certain.

sentences.zh: 祥乘小舟至低山下，以其人衆，不親上，令軍官劉閏等二百餘人以小舟十一艘，載軍器，領三嶼人陳煇者登岸。

translations.literal: Xiang took a small boat to the foot of the low mountain. Because his force was large he did not go ashore himself, but ordered Military Officer Liu Run and more than two hundred others in eleven small boats, carrying weapons and led by Chen Hui of the Three Islands, to go ashore.
translations.idiomatic: Xiang took a small boat to the foot of the low mountain. Because his force was large he did not go ashore himself, but ordered Military Officer Liu Run and more than two hundred others in eleven small boats, carrying weapons and led by Chen Hui of the Three Islands, to go ashore.

sentences.zh: 岸上人衆不曉三嶼人語，為其殺死者三人，遂還。

translations.literal: The people on shore did not understand the language of the Three Islands people, and three of them were killed. They then returned.
translations.idiomatic: The people on shore did not understand the language of the Three Islands people, and three of them were killed. They then returned.

sentences.zh: 四月二日，至彭湖。

translations.literal: On the second day of the fourth month they reached Penghu.
translations.idiomatic: On the second day of the fourth month they reached Penghu.

sentences.zh: 祥責鑒、志斗「已到琉求」文字，二人不從。

translations.literal: Xiang demanded that Jian and Zhidou write the words "already reached Liuqiu." The two refused.
translations.idiomatic: Xiang demanded that Jian and Zhidou write the words "already reached Liuqiu." The two refused.

sentences.zh: 明日，不見志斗蹤跡，覔之無有也。

translations.literal: The next day Zhidou's tracks were nowhere to be seen; searching for him, he could not be found.
translations.idiomatic: The next day Zhidou was nowhere to be found; searching for him, he could not be located.

sentences.zh: 先，志斗嘗斥言祥生事要功，欲取富貴，其言誕妄難信，至是，疑祥害之。

translations.literal: Earlier, Zhidou had denounced Xiang for stirring up trouble to claim merit and seek wealth and rank; his words were extravagant and hard to believe. At this point they suspected Xiang had harmed him.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, Zhidou had denounced Xiang for stirring up trouble to claim merit and seek wealth and rank; his words were extravagant and hard to believe. At this point they suspected Xiang had harmed him.

sentences.zh: 祥顧稱志斗初言琉求不可往，今祥已至琉求而還，志斗懼罪逃去。

translations.literal: Xiang, for his part, claimed that Zhidou had originally said Liuqiu could not be reached, but now that Xiang had reached Liuqiu and returned, Zhidou feared punishment and fled.
translations.idiomatic: Xiang, for his part, claimed that Zhidou had originally said Liuqiu could not be reached, but now that Xiang had reached Liuqiu and returned, Zhidou feared punishment and fled.

sentences.zh: 志斗妻子訴于官。

translations.literal: Zhidou's wife and children appealed to the authorities.
translations.idiomatic: Zhidou's wife and children appealed to the authorities.

sentences.zh: 有旨，發祥、鑒還福建置對。

translations.literal: An edict ordered Xiang and Jian sent back to Fujian for interrogation.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered Xiang and Jian sent back to Fujian for interrogation.

sentences.zh: 後遇赦，不竟其事。

translations.literal: Later an amnesty was granted and the matter was not pursued to conclusion.
translations.idiomatic: Later an amnesty was granted and the matter was not pursued to conclusion.

sentences.zh: 成宗元貞三年，福建省平章政事高興言，今立省泉州，距琉求為近，可伺其消息，或宜招宜伐，不必它調兵力，興請就近試之。

translations.literal: In the third year of Yuanzhen of Emperor Chengzong, Gao Xing, Grand Councillor of the Fujian Branch Secretariat, said that now with a provincial administration established at Quanzhou, which is close to Liuqiu, they could watch for news and either summon or campaign as appropriate without transferring troops from elsewhere. Gao requested to try it locally.
translations.idiomatic: In the third Yuanzhen year of Emperor Chengzong, Gao Xing, Grand Councillor of the Fujian Branch Secretariat, said that now with a provincial administration established at Quanzhou, which is close to Liuqiu, they could watch for news and either summon or campaign as appropriate without transferring troops from elsewhere. Gao requested to try it locally.

sentences.zh: 九月，高興遣省都鎮撫張浩、福州新軍萬戶張進赴琉求國，禽生口一百三十餘人。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, Gao Xing dispatched Provincial Chief Pacification Commissioner Zhang Hao and Fuzhou New Army Ten-thousand-household Commander Zhang Jin to Liuqiu and captured more than one hundred thirty living captives.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, Gao Xing dispatched Provincial Chief Pacification Commissioner Zhang Hao and Fuzhou New Army Ten-thousand-household Commander Zhang Jin to Liuqiu and captured more than one hundred thirty living captives.

sentences.zh: 三嶼國

translations.literal: The Three Islands Country
translations.idiomatic: The Three Islands Country

sentences.zh: 三嶼國，近琉求。

translations.literal: The Three Islands Country lies near Liuqiu.
translations.idiomatic: The Three Islands Country lies near Liuqiu.

sentences.zh: 世祖至元三十年，命選人招誘之。

translations.literal: In the thirtieth year of Zhiyuan of Emperor Shizu, men were selected to go and win them over.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirtieth Zhiyuan year of Emperor Shizu, men were selected to go and win them over.

sentences.zh: 平章政事伯顏等言：「臣等與識者議，此國之民不及二百戶，時有至泉州為商賈者。

translations.literal: Grand Councillor Bayan and others said: "We discussed this with those who know the region. The people of this country number fewer than two hundred households, and sometimes come to Quanzhou as merchants."
translations.idiomatic: Grand Councillor Bayan and others said: "We discussed this with those who know the region. The people of this country number fewer than two hundred households, and sometimes come to Quanzhou as merchants."

sentences.zh: 去年入琉求，軍船過其國，國人餉以糧食，館我將校，無它志也。

translations.literal: Last year when entering Liuqiu, military ships passed their country. The people supplied food and lodged our officers; they had no other designs.
translations.idiomatic: Last year when entering Liuqiu, military ships passed their country. The people supplied food and lodged our officers; they had no other designs.

sentences.zh: 乞不遣使。

translations.literal: We request that no envoy be sent.
translations.idiomatic: We request that no envoy be sent.

sentences.zh: 」帝從之。

translations.literal: The emperor agreed.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor agreed.

sentences.zh: 馬八兒等國

translations.literal: Maba'er and Other Countries
translations.idiomatic: Maba'er and Other Countries

sentences.zh: 海外諸蕃國，惟馬八兒與俱藍足以綱領諸國，而俱藍又為馬八兒後障，自泉州至其國約十萬里。

translations.literal: Among the various maritime barbarian countries overseas, only Maba'er and Julan are sufficient to lead the rest, and Julan is also the rear barrier of Maba'er. From Quanzhou to their countries is about one hundred thousand li.
translations.idiomatic: Among the various maritime countries overseas, only Maba'er and Julan are sufficient to lead the rest, and Julan is also the rear barrier of Maba'er. From Quanzhou to their countries is about one hundred thousand li.

sentences.zh: 其國至阿不合大王城，水路得便風，約十五日可到，比餘國最大。

translations.literal: From their country to the great city of Abaha, by water with a favorable wind it takes about fifteen days to arrive—it is larger than the other countries.
translations.idiomatic: From their country to the great city of Abaha, by water with a favorable wind it takes about fifteen days to arrive—it is larger than the other countries.

sentences.zh: 世祖至元間，行中書省左丞唆都等奉璽書十通，招諭諸蕃。

translations.literal: During the Zhiyuan era of Emperor Shizu, Suodu, Left Chancellor of the Branch Secretariat, and others received ten imperial letters of appointment to summon and instruct the various maritime countries.
translations.idiomatic: During Emperor Shizu's Zhiyuan era, Suodu, Left Chancellor of the Branch Secretariat, and others received ten imperial letters of appointment to summon and instruct the various maritime countries.

sentences.zh: 未幾，占城、馬八兒國俱奉表稱藩，餘俱藍諸國未下。

translations.literal: Before long, Champa and Maba'er both submitted memorials declaring themselves vassals; the remaining Julan countries had not yet submitted.
translations.idiomatic: Before long, Champa and Maba'er both submitted memorials declaring themselves vassals; the remaining Julan countries had not yet submitted.

sentences.zh: 行省議遣使十五人往諭之。

translations.literal: The Branch Secretariat deliberated on sending fifteen envoys to instruct them.
translations.idiomatic: The Branch Secretariat deliberated on sending fifteen envoys to instruct them.

sentences.zh: 帝曰：「非唆都等所可專也，若無朕命，不得擅遣使。」

translations.literal: The emperor said: "This is not something Suodu and the others may decide on their own. Without my command, envoys must not be dispatched on their own authority."
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said: "This is not something Suodu and the others may decide on their own. Without my command, envoys must not be dispatched on their own authority."

sentences.zh: 十六年十二月，遣廣東招討司達魯花赤楊庭璧招俱藍。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month of the sixteenth year, Yang Tingbi, Darughachi of the Guangdong Pacification Office, was dispatched to summon Julan.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month of the sixteenth year, Yang Tingbi, Darughachi of the Guangdong Pacification Office, was dispatched to summon Julan.

sentences.zh: 十七年三月，至其國。

translations.literal: In the third month of the seventeenth year he reached that country.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of the seventeenth year he reached that country.

sentences.zh: 國主必納的令其弟肯那却不剌木省書回回字降表，附庭璧以進，言來歲遣使入貢。

translations.literal: The king, Binadi, had his younger brother Kennaquebulam write a submission memorial in Arabic script and attach it to Tingbi to present, stating that next year they would send envoys to pay tribute.
translations.idiomatic: The king, Binadi, had his younger brother Kennaquebulam write a submission memorial in Arabic script and attach it to Tingbi to present, stating that next year they would send envoys to pay tribute.

sentences.zh: 十月，授哈撒兒海牙俱藍國宣慰使，偕庭璧再往招諭。

translations.literal: In the tenth month, Hasar Haiya was appointed Pacification Commissioner of Julan and went again with Tingbi to summon and instruct them.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, Hasar Haiya was appointed Pacification Commissioner of Julan and went again with Tingbi to summon and instruct them.

sentences.zh: 十八年正月，自泉州入海，行三月，抵僧伽耶山，舟人鄭震等以阻風乏糧，勸往馬八兒國，或可假陸路以達俱藍國，從之。

translations.literal: In the first month of the eighteenth year they set out to sea from Quanzhou. After three months' sailing they reached Sangayeshan. The boatmen Zheng Zhen and others, citing blocked winds and lack of provisions, advised going to Maba'er, where they might borrow a land route to reach Julan. They agreed.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the eighteenth year they set out to sea from Quanzhou. After three months' sailing they reached Sangayeshan. The boatmen Zheng Zhen and others, citing blocked winds and lack of provisions, advised going to Maba'er, where they might borrow a land route to reach Julan. They agreed.

sentences.zh: 四月，至馬八兒國新村馬頭，登岸。

translations.literal: In the fourth month they reached the new village wharf of Maba'er and went ashore.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month they reached the new village wharf of Maba'er and went ashore.

sentences.zh: 其國宰相馬因的謂：「官人此來甚善，本國船到泉州時官司亦嘗慰勞，無以為報。

translations.literal: The chancellor of that country, Mayinde, said: "Your coming here is most welcome. When our country's ships reached Quanzhou the authorities also once offered comfort, and we had no way to repay it."
translations.idiomatic: The chancellor of that country, Mayinde, said: "Your coming here is most welcome. When our country's ships reached Quanzhou the authorities also once offered comfort, and we had no way to repay it."

sentences.zh: 今以何事至此？

translations.literal: For what purpose have you come here now?
translations.idiomatic: For what purpose have you come here now?

sentences.zh: 」庭璧等告其故，因及假道之事，馬因的乃託以不通為辭。

translations.literal: Tingbi and the others explained their purpose and also raised the matter of borrowing a route. Mayinde then pleaded that the route was impassable.
translations.idiomatic: Tingbi and the others explained their purpose and also raised the matter of borrowing a route. Mayinde then pleaded that the route was impassable.

sentences.zh: 與其宰相不阿里相見，又言假道。

translations.literal: They met with the chancellor Bulali and again spoke of borrowing a route.
translations.idiomatic: They met with Chancellor Bulali and again spoke of borrowing a route.

sentences.zh: 不阿里亦以它事辭。

translations.literal: Bulali also declined on other grounds.
translations.idiomatic: Bulali also declined on other grounds.

sentences.zh: 五月，二人蚤至館，屏人，令其官者為通情實：「乞為達朝廷，我一心願為皇帝奴。

translations.literal: In the fifth month the two men came early to the guesthouse, dismissed attendants, and had their official convey the truth: "I beg you to report to the court: I wholeheartedly wish to be the emperor's servant."
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month the two men came early to the guesthouse, dismissed attendants, and had their official convey the truth: "I beg you to report to the court: I wholeheartedly wish to be the emperor's servant."

sentences.zh: 我使札馬里丁入朝，我大必闍赤赴筭彈華言國主也。

translations.literal: I sent Jamal al-Din to court. My elder brother, the great beichhi, went to Sandan and declared himself king in Chinese fashion.
translations.idiomatic: I sent Jamal al-Din to court. My elder brother, the great beichhi, went to Sandan and declared himself king in Chinese fashion.

sentences.zh: 告變，筭彈籍我金銀田產妻孥，又欲殺我，我詭辭得免。

translations.literal: He reported me for treason. Sandan confiscated my gold, silver, land, property, wife, and children, and also wanted to kill me. I escaped by deceitful words.
translations.idiomatic: He reported me for treason. Sandan confiscated my gold, silver, land, property, wife, and children, and also wanted to kill me. I escaped by deceitful words.

sentences.zh: 今筭彈兄弟五人皆聚加一之地，議與俱藍交兵；

translations.literal: Now Sandan and his five brothers are all gathered at Jiayi and are planning to make war on Julan.
translations.idiomatic: Now Sandan and his five brothers are all gathered at Jiayi and are planning to make war on Julan.

sentences.zh: 及聞天使來，對衆稱本國貧陋。

translations.literal: When he heard that the imperial envoy had come, he declared before the assembly that our country was poor and mean.
translations.idiomatic: When he heard that the imperial envoy had come, he declared before the assembly that our country was poor and mean.

sentences.zh: 此是妄言。

translations.literal: This is false talk.
translations.idiomatic: This is false talk.

sentences.zh: 凡回回國金珠寶貝盡出本國，其餘回回盡來商賈。

translations.literal: All the gold, pearls, and precious goods of the Muslim countries come from our country; the rest of the Muslims all come here to trade.
translations.idiomatic: All the gold, pearls, and precious goods of the Muslim countries come from our country; the rest of the Muslims all come here to trade.

sentences.zh: 此間諸國皆有降心，若馬八兒既下，我使人持書招之，可使盡降。

translations.literal: All the countries in this region are inclined to submit. If Maba'er is taken, I can send men with letters to summon them and make them all submit.
translations.idiomatic: All the countries in this region are inclined to submit. If Maba'er is taken, I can send men with letters to summon them and make them all submit.

sentences.zh: 」時哈撒兒海牙與庭璧以阻風不至俱藍，遂還。

translations.literal: At that time Hasar Haiya and Tingbi, blocked by winds, did not reach Julan and returned.
translations.idiomatic: At that time Hasar Haiya and Tingbi, blocked by winds, did not reach Julan and returned.

sentences.zh: 哈撒兒海牙入朝計事，期以十一月俟北風再舉。

translations.literal: Hasar Haiya went to court to plan affairs, setting November to wait for the north wind and try again.
translations.idiomatic: Hasar Haiya went to court to plan affairs, setting November to wait for the north wind and try again.

sentences.zh: 至期，朝廷遣使令庭璧獨往。

translations.literal: When the time came, the court dispatched an envoy ordering Tingbi to go alone.
translations.idiomatic: When the time came, the court dispatched an envoy ordering Tingbi to go alone.

sentences.zh: 十九年二月，抵俱藍國。

translations.literal: In the second month of the nineteenth year he reached Julan.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of the nineteenth year he reached Julan.

sentences.zh: 國主及其相馬合麻等迎拜璽書。

translations.literal: The king and his chancellor Mahema and others came to welcome and receive the imperial letter.
translations.idiomatic: The king and his chancellor Mahema and others came to welcome and receive the imperial letter.

sentences.zh: 三月，遣其臣祝阿里沙忙里八的入貢。

translations.literal: In the third month they sent their minister Zhualisha Manglibadi to pay tribute.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month they sent their minister Zhualisha Manglibadi to pay tribute.

sentences.zh: 時也里可溫兀咱兒撒里馬及木速蠻主馬合麻等亦在其國，聞詔使至，皆相率來告願納歲幣，遣使入覲。

translations.literal: At that time the Yelikewen Wuzarsalima and the Musuman leader Mahema were also in that country. Hearing that the imperial envoy had arrived, they all came in succession to declare their wish to pay annual tribute and send envoys to court.
translations.idiomatic: At that time the Yelikewen Wuzarsalima and the Musuman leader Mahema were also in that country. Hearing that the imperial envoy had arrived, they all came in succession to declare their wish to pay annual tribute and send envoys to court.

sentences.zh: 會蘇木達國亦遣人因俱藍主乞降，庭璧皆從其請。

translations.literal: At the same time Sumuda also sent men through the king of Julan to request submission, and Tingbi granted all their requests.
translations.idiomatic: At the same time Sumuda also sent men through the king of Julan to request submission, and Tingbi granted all their requests.

sentences.zh: 四月，還至那旺國。

translations.literal: In the fourth month he returned to Nawang.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month he returned to Nawang.

sentences.zh: 庭璧復說下其主忙昂比。

translations.literal: Tingbi again persuaded its king, Mangangbi, to submit.
translations.idiomatic: Tingbi again persuaded its king, Mangangbi, to submit.

sentences.zh: 至蘇木都剌國，國主土漢八的迎使者。

translations.literal: Reaching Sumudula, the king, Tuhanbadi, welcomed the envoy.
translations.idiomatic: Reaching Sumudula, the king, Tuhanbadi, welcomed the envoy.

sentences.zh: 庭璧因喻以大意，土漢八的即日納款稱藩，遣其臣哈散、速里蠻二人入朝。

translations.literal: Tingbi explained the main points to him, and Tuhanbadi that same day submitted and declared himself a vassal, sending his ministers Hasan and Suliman to court.
translations.idiomatic: Tingbi explained the main points to him, and Tuhanbadi that same day submitted and declared himself a vassal, sending his ministers Hasan and Suliman to court.

sentences.zh: 二十年，馬八兒國遣僧撮及班入朝；

translations.literal: In the twentieth year, Maba'er sent the monks Suo and Ban to court.
translations.idiomatic: In the twentieth year, Maba'er sent the monks Suo and Ban to court.

sentences.zh: 五月，將至上京，帝即遣使迓諸途。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, as they were about to reach the Upper Capital, the emperor immediately dispatched envoys to welcome them along the route.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, as they were about to reach the Upper Capital, the emperor immediately dispatched envoys to welcome them along the route.

sentences.zh: 二十三年，海外諸蕃國以楊庭璧奉詔招諭至是皆來降。

translations.literal: In the twenty-third year, the various maritime barbarian countries overseas, because Yang Tingbi had carried out imperial orders to summon and instruct them, all came to submit by this time.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-third year, the various maritime countries overseas, because Yang Tingbi had carried out imperial orders to summon and instruct them, had all come to submit by this time.

sentences.zh: 諸國凡十：曰馬八兒，曰須門那，曰僧急里，曰南無力，曰馬蘭丹，曰那旺，曰丁呵兒，曰來來，曰急蘭亦，曰蘇木都剌，皆遣使貢方物。

translations.literal: The countries numbered ten: Maba'er, Xumenna, Sengjili, Nanwuli, Malandan, Nawang, Dingha'er, Lailai, Jilanyi, and Sumudula—all sent envoys presenting local products.
